gametext: Fellowship: Spot an Elf to reveal the top card of your draw deck. Heal up to 2 companions whose culture matches the revealed card. You may discard the revealed card.

title: Naith Longbow
gametext:
Bearer must be an Elf companion.
Archery: Exert bearer to discard the top card of your draw deck. If it is an [elven] card, exert a minion.

title: Naith Troop
gametext:
To play, spot 3 Elf companions.
Skirmish: Exert Naith Troop to discard the top card of your draw deck. If it is an [elven] card, make a minion skirmishing Naith Troop strength -2.

title: Naith Warband
gametext:
To play, spot 3 Elf companions.
While Naith Warband bears a ranged weapon, it takes no more than 1 wound during each skirmish phase and does not add to the fellowship archery total.

title: Boomed and Trumpeted
gametext: Skirmish: Make an Ent strength +X and damage +X, where X is the number of unbound Hobbits you can spot.

title: Crack Into Rubble
gametext: Regroup: Exert 2 Ents to liberate a site and discard a Shadow condition.

title: Enraged
gametext:
Bearer must be an Ent. Limit 1 per bearer.
Discard this condition at the end of the turn.

title: Ent Avenger
gametext: While you can spot 3 Ents, this companion is strength +2.

title: Ent Horde
gametext:
To play, spot 2 Ent companions.
Ent Horde's twilight cost is -2 for each Ent or unbound Hobbit you can spot.
While you can spot more minions than companions, Ent Horde is defender +1.

title: Ent Moot
gametext: To play, exert an unbound Hobbit. Bearer must be an Ent. Limit 1 per bearer.

title: Gandalf
gametext:
Damage +1.
Each time the fellowship moves, wound Gandalf.
subtitle: Mithrandir

title: Glamdring
gametext:
Bearer must be Gandalf.
He is damage +1.
Each time you play a spell during a skirmish, you may make Gandalf damage +1 until the end of that skirmish.
subtitle: Lightning Brand

title: Host of Fangorn
gametext:
To play, spot 2 Ent companions.
Host of Fangorn's twilight cost is -2 for each Ent or unbound Hobbit you can spot.

title: Quickbeam
gametext: Quickbeam's twilight cost is -1 for each Ent or unbound Hobbit you can spot.
subtitle: Bregalad

title: Roused
gametext: Skirmish: Exert an Ent to make him strength +1 for each Ent you spot (limit +4).

title: Skinbark
gametext:
Skinbark's twilight cost is -1 for each Ent or unbound Hobbit you can spot.
Response: If an unbound Hobbit is about to take a wound, exert Skinbark to prevent that wound.
subtitle: Fladrif

title: Threw Down My Enemy
gametext:
Spell.
Skirmish: Make a minion skirmishing Gandalf strength -1 for each wound on each character in the skirmish.

title: Treebeard
gametext:
Unhasty.
Assignment: Exert an unbound Hobbit to allow Treebeard to skirmish.
Skirmish: Exert Treebeard to make an Ent damage +1.
subtitle: Guardian of the Forest

title: Don't Follow the Lights
gametext: Response: If Sméagol wins a skirmish, add a burden to discard a minion.

title: Don't Look at Them
gametext:
Plays to your support area.
Skirmish: Spot Sméagol and discard 3 cards from hand to wound a minion Sméagol is skirmishing once (or twice if that minion is a [wraith] minion).

title: Gollum
gametext: Skirmish: Discard a card from hand to make Gollum strength +1 (or +2 if skirmishing a Ring-bound companion).
subtitle: Old Villain

title: Master Broke His Promise
gametext: Regroup: Exert Gollum 3 times to wound each companion. The move limit for this turn is -1.

title: Nasty, Foul Hobbitses
gametext: Response: If Gollum wins a skirmish, add a burden.

title: Not Listening
gametext: Response: If Sméagol wins a skirmish, heal him and remove 2 burdens.

title: Safe Paths
gametext: Regroup: Exert Sméagol 3 times and discard him to wound each minion. The move limit for this turn is +1. If the fellowship moves, each Shadow player may take up to 3 Shadow cards into hand from his or her discard pile.

title: Sméagol
gametext:
Ring-bound. To play, add a burden.
Skirmish: Discard a card from hand to make Sméagol strength +1.
subtitle: Poor Creature

title: They Stole It
gametext:
Plays to your support area.
Skirmish: Spot Gollum and discard 3 cards from hand to wound a companion Gollum is skirmishing once (or twice if that companion is a [shire] companion).

title: You're a Liar and a Thief
gametext: Response: If Gollum wins a skirmish, wound a companion (except the Ring- bearer).

title: Anborn
gametext:
Ring-bound. Ranger.
Each time Anborn wins a skirmish, you may make a minion's site number +3 until the regroup phase.
subtitle: Skilled Huntsman

title: Ancient Roads
gametext:
Plays to your support area.
While you can spot 3 rangers, the site number of each minion skirmishing a ranger is +2.

title: Aragorn
gametext:
Skirmish: Remove an [elven] token to make a minion skirmishing Aragorn strength -3.
Skirmish: Remove a [dwarven] token to heal a Dwarf.
Regroup: If Aragorn is mounted, remove a [rohan] token to wound a minion twice.
subtitle: Defender of Free Peoples

title: Banner of Westernesse
gametext:
Bearer must be a [gondor] companion.
Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may heal another [gondor] companion.
Response: If bearer wins a skirmish, discard this possession to liberate a site.

title: Garrison of Osgiliath
gametext:
Fortification. Plays to your support area.
When you play this condition, you may spot a [gondor] Man to place 2 [gondor] tokens here.
Skirmish: Discard this condition or remove a [gondor] token from here to make a [gondor] Man strength +1.

title: Mortal Men
gametext: Skirmish: Make a [gondor] Man strength +2 (and exert a minion if you spot a [rohan] token).

title: Perilous Ventures
gametext: Regroup: Exert 2 rangers to discard a minion (or 2 [wraith] minions).

title: Ring of Barahir
gametext:
Bearer must be Aragorn.
At the start of each of your turns, you may spot a culture token to heal a companion of that culture.

title: Trust
gametext: Skirmish: Make a [gondor] Man strength +2 (and heal a companion if you spot an [elven] token).

title: Agents of Orthanc
gametext: This minion is strength +2 and damage +1 for each Free Peoples culture that you can spot over 2.

title: Assault Ladder
gametext:
Machine. Plays to your support area.
Shadow: Exert an Uruk-hai to place an [isengard] token on this card.
Skirmish: Spot 3 [isengard] tokens here to make an Uruk-hai strength +3. Discard this condition.

title: Banner of Isengard
gametext:
Bearer must be an [isengard] minion.
Each time bearer wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player must exert a companion for each site you control.

title: Berserk Butcher
gametext:
Damage +1.
Berserk Butcher is strength +1 for each wound on each character in its skirmish.
Maneuver: Remove an [isengard] token from a machine and exert Berserk Butcher twice to prevent all wounds to Uruk-hai until the assignment phase.

title: Desertion
gametext:
To play, spot an [isengard] Man. Plays on a companion (except the Ring-bearer).
Assignment: Assign an [isengard] minion with less strength than bearer to skirmish bearer. Discard this condition.

title: Fires and Foul Fumes
gametext: Regroup: Discard 4 [isengard] Orcs to wound a companion 4 times (except the Ring-bearer).

title: Gnawing, Biting, Hacking, Burning
gametext:
Plays to your support area.
Each time a regroup action discards an [isengard] Orc, you may stack that Orc on this card.
Shadow: Discard 2 cards stacked here and remove (1) to play an [isengard] Orc from your discard pile.

title: Iron Fist of the Orc
gametext:
Plays to your support area.
Each time a regroup action discards an [isengard] Orc, you may stack that Orc on this card.
Regroup: Discard 3 cards stacked here and remove (1) to discard a Free Peoples possession.

title: Isengard Artisan
gametext: Regroup: Discard an [isengard] Orc to make the Free Peoples player wound a companion.

title: Isengard Builder
gametext: Regroup: If stacked on an [isengard] card, discard this card to add (2).

title: Isengard Journeyman
gametext: Regroup: Discard an [isengard] Orc to make the Free Peoples player wound a companion.

title: Isengard Mechanics
gametext:
Regroup: Discard an [isengard] Orc to make the Free Peoples player wound a companion (or 2 companions if you spot 6 companions).
Regroup: If this minion is stacked on an [isengard] card, spot an [isengard] Orc and discard this minion to add (3).

title: Isengard Plodder
gametext: Regroup: Discard an [isengard] Orc to make the Free Peoples player wound a companion.

title: Isengard Tender
gametext: Regroup: If stacked on an [isengard] card, discard this card and remove (2) to exhaust a companion.

title: Isengard Tinker
gametext: Regroup: Discard an [isengard] Orc to make the Free Peoples player wound a companion.

title: Rohirrim Traitor
gametext: While you can spot a companion bearing an [isengard] condition, this minion is strength +2.

title: Scaffolding
gametext:
Plays to your support area.
Each time a regroup action discards an [isengard] Orc, you may stack that Orc on this card.
Response: If an [isengard] Orc is about to take a wound, discard 2 cards stacked here to prevent that wound.

title: Sharku
gametext:
Warg-rider.
While Sharku is not exhausted, he is fierce.
Regroup: Exert Sharku to add (1).
subtitle: Vile Marauder

title: Twisted Tales
gametext:
Plays to your support area.
Each time a companion or ally loses a skirmish involving an [isengard] Man, you may spot a possession to stack that possession here.

title: The Balrog
gametext:
Damage +2.
The twilight cost of The Balrog is -3 if you can spot a [moria] minion.
The Balrog cannot be assigned to skirmish companions or allies of strength less than 6.
subtitle: Terror of Flame and Shadow

title: Durin's Tower
gametext:
Plays to your support area. At sites 2[T] and 3[T], The Balrog's twilight cost is -3.
Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a unique [moria] minion strength +3.

title: Easterling Army
gametext:
Easterling. Fierce.
Skirmish: Spot 2 burdens and exert this minion to make an Easterling strength +1.
Skirmish: Spot 4 burdens and exert this minion to make an Easterling strength +2.
Skirmish: Spot 6 burdens and exert this minion to make an Easterling strength +3.

title: Easterling Polearm
gametext:
Bearer must be an Easterling.
While you can spot 2 burdens, bearer cannot take wounds.
While you can spot 5 burdens, bearer is damage +1.

title: Southron Archer Legion
gametext:
Southron. Archer.
Archery: Remove (3) to add 1 to the minion archery total for each companion over 4 (limit +4).

title: Southron Invaders
gametext:
Southron. Ambush (1).
When you play this minion, you may spot another Southron to play a minion with ambush from your discard pile.

title: Trample
gametext: Maneuver: Spot a mounted [raider] Man to discard a companion (except the Ring-bearer). The Free Peoples player may add (4) to prevent this.

title: Fell Beast
gametext:
To play, discard 2 cards from hand. Bearer must be a Nazgûl.
Bearer is fierce.

title: Spied From Above
gametext:
Plays to your support area.
Regroup: Exert a Nazgûl twice to play a [wraith] or [sauron] minion. That minion's twilight cost is -8 and it comes into play exhausted.

title: Sword of Dol Guldur
gametext:
Bearer must be a Nazgûl.
While bearer is Úlairë Toldëa, each time he wins a skirmish the Free Peoples player must discard a Free Peoples possession or a Free Peoples condition.

title: Úlairë Lemenya
gametext: Regroup: Exert Úlairë Lemenya and discard 3 cards from hand to return a companion (except the Ring-bearer) to owner's hand.
subtitle: Winged Hunter

title: Úlairë Nertëa
gametext: When you play Úlairë Nertëa, spot another Nazgûl to make the Free Peoples player exert a Ring-bound companion for each Free Peoples culture you can spot over 2.
subtitle: Winged Hunter

title: Úlairë Toldëa
gametext:
Fierce.
Each time Úlairë Toldëa wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player must exert a companion or add a burden.
subtitle: Winged Sentry

title: Winged and Ominous
gametext:
Plays to your support area.
Regroup: Exert a Nazgûl to place a [wraith] token on this card.
Shadow: Remove 3 [wraith] tokens from here to add (2).

title: Banner of the Mark
gametext:
Bearer must be a [rohan] companion.
Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may exert a minion.
Response: If bearer wins a skirmish, discard this possession to liberate a site.

title: Blood Has Been Spilled
gametext:
Plays to your support area.
Skirmish: Discard a mount borne by a [rohan] Man to prevent that Man from being overwhelmed unless his or her strength is tripled.

title: Éomer
gametext:
Valiant. While you can spot a [rohan] Man, Éomer's twilight cost is -1.
Skirmish: Discard 3 cards from hand to make a [rohan] Man strength +2 for each wound on each minion in his or her skirmish.
subtitle: Rohirrim Captain

title: Ever the Hope of Men
gametext: Regroup: Exert 2 mounted [rohan] Men to discard up to 2 wounded minions.

title: Háma
gametext:
To play, spot a [rohan] Man.
Skirmish: Exert Háma to discard a possession borne by a minion he is skirmishing.
subtitle: Doorward of Théoden

title: Hrethel
gametext:
To play, spot a [rohan] Man.
Skirmish: Heal a minion skirmishing Hrethel to make Hrethel strength +3 (limit +3).
subtitle: Rider of Rohan

title: News From the Mark
gametext: Fellowship: Spot 3 mounted [rohan] Men to make the move limit for this turn +2. Each Shadow player may draw 6 cards.

title: We Left None Alive
gametext:
Plays to your support area. When you play this condition, you may spot a [rohan] Man to place 2 [rohan] tokens here.
Skirmish: Discard this condition or remove a [rohan] token from here to make a [rohan] Man skirmishing an exhausted minion strength +2.

title: Banner of the Eye
gametext:
Bearer must be a [sauron] Orc.
Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may add (1) for each site you control.

title: Corpse Lights
gametext:
Twilight.
Skirmish: Exert this minion to make a [sauron] or twilight minion strength +1 for each twilight minion you can spot.

title: Dead Ones
gametext:
Twilight. Damage +1.
To play this minion, remove a burden or spot a twilight minion.

title: Gate Picket
gametext: Maneuver: Exert this minion twice to make the Free Peoples player name 3 cultures. Wound each companion and ally not of a named culture.

title: Gate Sentry
gametext: Maneuver: Exert this minion twice and spot another [sauron] minion to discard a condition.

title: Gate Troll
gametext:
Fierce.
While you can spot a Troll, Gate Troll's twilight cost is -4.
For each other [sauron] minion you can spot, this minion is strength +1.

title: Orc Insurgent
gametext: Shadow: Exert this minion to draw X cards and add (X), where X is the number of Free Peoples cultures you spot over 2.

title: Peril
gametext:
Plays to your support area.
Regroup: Exert a [sauron] Orc to play a Nazgûl or [sauron] minion. Its twilight cost is -4 and it comes into play exhausted.

title: Troll of Udûn
gametext:
Fierce.
While you can spot a Troll, this minion's twilight cost is -4.
Skirmish: Discard a [sauron] card from hand to make this minion strength +1.

title: Troll's Chain
gametext:
Bearer must be a [sauron] Troll.
When you play this possession, you may draw a card.

title: Wisp of Pale Sheen
gametext:
Twilight.
Regroup: Spot another [sauron] or twilight minion and discard this minion to add a burden.

title: Held
gametext:
Bearer must be Frodo.
Each time Frodo is about to be killed by a wound, add a burden instead.
When the fellowship moves to site 9, Frodo is corrupted.
Regroup: If you can spot no minions, discard this condition.

title: It Burns Us
gametext: Regroup: Spot Sam and Sméagol (or Gollum) to choose an opponent who must reveal his or her hand. Wound a minion X times, where X is the number of different cultures revealed.

title: Kept Safe
gametext:
Plays to your support area. When you play this condition, place 2 [shire] tokens here.
Response: If an unbound Hobbit is about to take a wound, discard this condition or remove a [shire] token from here to prevent that wound.

title: Long Slow Wrath
gametext: Skirmish: Exert an unbound Hobbit to make him strength +1 and damage +1 for each [gandalf] companion you can spot.

title: Merry
gametext: Regroup: Discard Merry to heal a [gandalf] companion.
subtitle: Impatient Hobbit

title: Pippin
gametext: Regroup: Discard Pippin to choose a Shadow player who must wound one of his or her minions.
subtitle: Hastiest of All

title: Rocks of Emyn Muil
gametext: Fellowship: Play a companion with the Frodo signet to remove a burden.

title: Westfold
gametext: Fellowship: Exert Aragorn twice to play a companion with the Aragorn signet from your draw deck.

title: Meduseld
gametext: Sanctuary. Fellowship: Exert 3 companions with the Gandalf signet to play an unbound companion from your dead pile.

title: Hornburg Hall
gametext: Sanctuary. Fellowship: Spot 3 companions with the Théoden signet and discard your hand to draw 4 cards.

title: Valley of Saruman
gametext: When the fellowship moves to this site, discard all allies.

title: Saruman's Laboratory
gametext: Response: If your minion is about to take a wound, discard 2 cards from hand to prevent that wound.

title: Faramir
gametext:
Ring-bound. Ranger.
If Faramir is in your starting fellowship, his twilight cost is -1.
Fellowship: Play a ranger to heal a Ring-bound companion.
subtitle: Ithilien Ranger

title: The Witch-king
gametext:
Fierce.
Each time a companion is killed in a skirmish involving a Nazgûl, wound an ally twice or exert a companion.
subtitle: Deathless Lord

title: The One Ring
gametext:
Response: If bearer is about to take a wound in a skirmish, he wears The One Ring until the regroup phase.
While wearing The One Ring, each time the Ring-bearer is about to take a wound during a skirmish, add a burden instead.
subtitle: The Ruling Ring

title: The One Ring
gametext:
Maneuver: Add a burden to wear The One Ring until the regroup phase.
While wearing The One Ring, each time the Ring-bearer is about to take a wound, add a burden instead.
subtitle: Such a Weight to Carry

title: Battle Tested
gametext: Make a Dwarf strength +2 (+4 if you spot a card stacked on a [dwarven] condition).

title: Calculated Risk
gametext: Spot a Dwarf and add a threat to draw 3 cards.

title: Dark Ways
gametext:
To play, spot a Dwarf.
Each time the fellowship moves, add a threat or discard this condition.
Regroup: Discard this condition to heal a Dwarf twice and take a [dwarven] skirmish event into hand from your discard pile.

title: Gimli
gametext:
Damage +1.
While you have initiative, Gimli is strength +2.
subtitle: Faithful Companion

title: Gimli
gametext:
Damage +1.
Response: If a [dwarven] condition is about to be discarded by an opponent, exert a Dwarf or discard a [dwarven] card from hand to prevent that.
subtitle: Feared Axeman

title: Gimli's Armor
gametext:
Bearer must be Gimli.
Response: If you have initiative and Gimli is about to take a wound, discard 2 cards from hand to prevent that wound.

title: Gimli's Battle Axe
gametext:
Bearer must be a Dwarf.
While you can spot a threat, bearer is damage +1.
While you can spot 2 threats, bearer is strength +1.
While you can spot 3 threats, the fellowship archery total is +1.
subtitle: Trusted Weapon

title: Loyalty Unshaken
gametext:
When you play this condition, you may stack 2 cards from hand here and draw a card for each [dwarven] card you stack.
Skirmish: Make a Dwarf strength +2. Also, make that Dwarf damage +2 for each [dwarven] card stacked on this condition. Discard this condition.

title: Out of Darkness
gametext: Make a Dwarf strength +2. You may also exert that Dwarf to draw 2 cards.

title: Preparations
gametext:
Regroup: Exert a Dwarf companion to stack a card from your discard pile here.
Skirmish: Wound a minion skirmishing a Dwarf once for each [dwarven] card stacked here. Discard this condition.

title: Reckless Pride
gametext:
Bearer must be a [dwarven] companion.
Each minion gains this ability: "Assignment: Assign this minion to bearer of Reckless Pride."
Regroup: Discard this condition to draw 4 cards.

title: Slaked Thirsts
gametext: Choose one: Spot a Dwarf to draw a card; or, if this card is stacked on a [dwarven] condition, spot a Dwarf companion and discard this event to exert a minion twice.

title: Ancient Blade
gametext:
Bearer must be an [elven] companion.
Each minion gains this ability: "Assignment: Assign this minion to bearer of Ancient Blade."
Regroup: Discard this condition to discard a minion and reconcile your hand.

title: Arwen
gametext: While skirmishing a fierce minion, Arwen is strength +3.
subtitle: Fair Elf Maiden

title: Asfaloth
gametext:
Bearer must be an Elf.
Skirmish: If bearer is Arwen, exert her to make each minion skirmishing her strength -2.
subtitle: Elven Steed

title: Bow of the Galadhrim
gametext:
Bearer must be Legolas.
Each time you play an [elven] skirmish event during a skirmish involving Legolas, you may heal him.
subtitle: Gift of Galadriel

title: Careful Study
gametext: Spot an Elf and discard 3 cards from hand to reconcile your hand.

title: Defiance
gametext: Make an Elf strength +2 (or +4 if skirmishing a Nazgûl).

title: Elrond
gametext:
To play, spot Aragorn or an Elf.
At the start of each turn, you may exert Elrond to heal a character bearing an artifact.
subtitle: Elven Lord

title: Hope Comes
gametext:
To play, spot 2 Elves.
Response: If an [elven] skirmish event is played, discard this condition to draw 3 cards.

title: Into the West
gametext: Regroup: Exert an Elf to reveal the top card of your draw deck. If it is an [elven] card, remove 3 threats. Place the revealed card beneath your draw deck.

title: Leaving Forever
gametext:
To play, spot 3 Elves.
Each time the fellowship moves, add a threat or discard this condition.
Regroup: Discard this condition to discard a condition or draw 2 cards.

title: Legolas
gametext:
Archer.
Archery: If you have initiative, discard 4 cards from hand to wound a minion.
subtitle: Fearless Marksman

title: Legolas
gametext:
Archer.
Archery: If you cannot spot a threat, add a threat to make the fellowship archery total +1.
subtitle: Nimble Warrior

title: Mirkwood Bowman
gametext: Exert 2 [elven] companions to discard the top 3 cards of your draw deck. Make the fellowship archery total +1 for each [elven] card discarded.

title: Shadow Between
gametext:
To play, spot an Elf.
At the start of your regroup phase, you may discard this condition or a card from hand to heal an Elf.

title: Still Needed
gametext: Make an Elf strength +2. You may place this event on top of your draw deck.

title: Uncertain Paths
gametext: Make an Elf strength +2 and you may shuffle your draw deck.

title: All Save One
gametext: Make Gandalf strength +2 (or +4 and damage +1 if you have initiative).

title: The Board Is Set
gametext:
Spell.
If an event is played, exert Gandalf to make that opponent remove (2) or cancel that event.

title: Citadel to Gate
gametext: Exert Gandalf twice to remove all threats and to heal all companions of one culture (except [gandalf]).

title: Echoes of Valinor
gametext: Each time Gandalf wins a skirmish, you may exert him to draw 2 cards.

title: Fool's Hope
gametext: Spot Gandalf and discard 2 cards from hand to make an opponent discard all but 2 Shadow conditions.

title: Gandalf
gametext: While you cannot spot 3 companions of the same culture, Gandalf is strength -2.
subtitle: Defender of the West

title: Gandalf
gametext: Skirmish: Place 3 cards from hand on top of your draw deck to make a minion skirmishing an unbound companion strength -3. Any Shadow player may place 3 cards from his or her hand on top of his or her draw deck to prevent this.
subtitle: Manager of Wizards

title: Gandalf's Staff
gametext:
Bearer must be Gandalf.
While you can spot 4 twilight tokens, Gandalf is strength +1.
subtitle: Focus of Power

title: Glamdring
gametext:
Bearer must be Gandalf.
He is damage +1.
Skirmish: If you have more cards in hand than each opponent, discard 2 cards from hand to make an opponent exert a minion.
subtitle: Elven Blade

title: Have Patience
gametext: Spot Gandalf to heal an unbound companion twice.

title: Intimidate
gametext:
Spell.
If a companion is about to take a wound, spot Gandalf to prevent that wound.

title: King's Advisor
gametext: Exert Gandalf twice to make an opponent exert a minion for each [rohan] companion you spot.

title: Light the Beacons
gametext: Exert Gandalf three times (or twice if you have initiative) to make all unbound companions of one culture (except [gandalf]) strength +3 until the regroup phase.

title: Moment of Respite
gametext: At the start of your regroup phase, you may discard 2 cards from hand to heal Gandalf.

title: Númenor's Pride

While you can spot 5 threats, bearer is damage +1.

title: Out of Sight and Shot
gametext:
To play, spot a Nazgûl.
Each time a companion is played, the Free Peoples player must exert a companion.
Shadow: Spot a Nazgûl and discard this condition to play a Nazgûl from your discard pile.

title: Put Forth His Strength
gametext:
To play, spot a Nazgûl.
Shadow: If you have initiative and there are 3 characters in the dead pile, spot 3 burdens, 3 threats and a Nazgûl to corrupt the Ring-bearer.

title: Stronghold of Minas Morgul
gametext:
Response: If your [wraith] minion wins a skirmish, place a [wraith] token here (limit 1 per site).
Regroup: Spot 3 [wraith] tokens here to exhaust the Ring-bearer. Discard this condition.

title: Their Power Is in Terror
gametext: Exert a Nazgûl to wound each ally.

title: There Came a Cry
gametext: Spot a Nazgûl to add a threat (or 3 threats if you have initiative).

title: Too Late
gametext:
Skirmish: Transfer this condition from your support area to a character skirmishing a Nazgûl.
Each time bearer exerts, add (1).

title: Úlairë Attëa
gametext:
Fierce.
Shadow: If you have initiative, exert Úlairë Attëa and spot another [wraith] minion to add a burden.
subtitle: Wraith on Wings

title: Úlairë Cantëa
gametext:
Fierce.
When you play Úlairë Cantëa, add a threat for each companion over 4.
Maneuver: Remove 2 threats and spot another [wraith] minion to discard a possession.
subtitle: Faster Than Winds

title: Úlairë Enquëa
gametext:
Fierce.
While you can spot 6 companions, Úlairë Enquëa is damage +1.
Each time a companion is killed, you may exert Úlairë Enquëa to exert the Ring-bearer.
subtitle: Faster Than Winds

title: Úlairë Lemenya
gametext:
Úlairë Lemenya is strength +1 for each other [wraith] minion you can spot.
While you can spot 3 [wraith] minions Úlairë Lemenya is fierce.
While you can spot 4 [wraith] minions Úlairë Lemenya is damage +1.
subtitle: Assailing Minion

title: Úlairë Lemenya
gametext: Regroup: If you have initiative, discard Úlairë Lemenya to discard a possession.
subtitle: Wraith on Wings

title: Úlairë Nelya
gametext:
Fierce.
Skirmish: Discard a [wraith] minion to make Úlairë Nelya strength +2.
subtitle: Assailing Minion

title: Úlairë Nelya
gametext:
Fierce.
Regroup: If you have initiative, discard Úlairë Nelya to exert each Ring-bound companion.
subtitle: Black-Mantled Wraith

title: Úlairë Nertëa
gametext: Regroup: If you have initiative, discard Úlairë Nertëa to add a burden.
subtitle: Black-Mantled Wraith

title: Úlairë Otsëa

subtitle: Black-Mantled Wraith

title: Úlairë Toldëa
gametext:
Fierce.
While you have initiative and can spot a Nazgûl, Úlairë Toldëa's twilight cost is -6.
subtitle: Wraith on Wings

title: War Long Planned
gametext: Make a [wraith] Orc strength +2 (or +4 if you spot 2 wounds on the Ring-bearer).

title: The Witch-king
gametext:
Fierce.
When you play The Witch-king, you may remove a threat to take a [wraith] card into hand from your discard pile.
The Ring-bearer cannot take threat wounds.
subtitle: Morgul King

title: Déor
gametext:
Villager.
Skirmish: If you have initiative, discard a card from hand to make a [rohan] Man strength +1.

gametext: Spot a mounted [rohan] Man to exert a minion. That minion's owner may exert a companion and if he or she does so, you may exert a minion; repeat this until a player does not exert a character.

Valiant.

Valiant. While you can spot a [rohan] Man, Éomer's twilight cost is -1.

subtitle: Skilled Tactician

Valiant.

While skirmishing a fierce minion, Éowyn is strength +2.

When you play this possession, you may wound a minion Éowyn is skirmishing.

Valiant.

gametext: Spot 3 [rohan] Men to make an opponent remove (1) or place a random card from hand beneath his or her draw deck. Do this once for each card in that player's hand when you play this event.

gametext: Choose an opponent. For each mounted companion you spot, that opponent must remove (1) or place a random card from hand beneath his or her draw deck.

gametext:
Villager.

Bearer must be Merry.

gametext: Make a [rohan] Man strength +4. Any Shadow player may place a random card from hand beneath his or her draw deck to make that Man strength +2 instead.

While at a plains site, bearer takes no more than 1 wound during each skirmish.

Valiant. While you can spot a [rohan] Man, Théoden's twilight cost is -1.
Each time the fellowship moves, you may exert a [rohan] companion to exert a minion.

gametext:
While you can spot a [rohan] Man, Théoden's twilight cost is -1.

Bearer must be a [rohan] Man.
At the start of each skirmish involving bearer, each minion skirmishing bearer must exert.

Bearer must be a [sauron] Orc.

gametext: Choose an opponent to discard the top card of his or her draw deck. If the twilight cost of that card is less than the number of besiegers you spot, take control of a site and all besiegers are strength +3 until the regroup phase.

gametext:
For each 2 sites you control, the twilight cost of each of your [sauron] cards is -1.
Regroup: Spot a [sauron] minion to draw a card (or draw 2 cards instead if that minion is a besieger). Discard this condition.

gametext:
The site number of each [sauron] Orc is -1 for each threat.
While you can spot 3 threats, each [sauron] Orc that is not roaming is strength +1.

Besieger.

Besieger.

Besieger.
When you play this minion from a site you control, add 2 threats.

Besieger.
Regroup: Discard 2 cards from hand to stack a [sauron] Orc on a site you control (or discard 1 card from hand if that Orc is a besieger).

title: Gorgoroth Officer
gametext:
Besieger.
Skirmish: Discard 2 cards from hand to play a [sauron] Orc stacked on a site you control. That Orc is fierce and strength +6 until the regroup phase.

title: Gorgoroth Pillager
gametext:
Besieger.
While this minion is stacked on a site you control, besiegers are fierce.

title: Gorgoroth Ransacker
gametext:
Besieger.
Skirmish: If this minion is stacked on a site you control, discard him to make a [sauron] Orc strength +5 (or +10 if you have initiative).

title: Gorgoroth Sapper
gametext:
Besieger.
Shadow: Discard 2 cards from hand to play a [sauron] Orc stacked on a site you control (discard 1 card from hand instead if that Orc is a besieger).

title: Gorgoroth Soldier
gametext:
Besieger.
Response: If a besieger is about to take a wound, discard 2 cards from hand to prevent it.

title: Gorgoroth Troop
gametext:
Besieger.
Skirmish: Stack your besieger on a site you control to make Gorgoroth Troop strength +2.

To play, spot a besieger or a site you control.

Engine.
Shadow: Play a besieger to place a [sauron] token here.
Skirmish: Remove a [sauron] token from a condition to make a [sauron] Orc strength +1 (limit +2).

gametext: When you play Host of Udûn, you may remove X threats to make its twilight cost -X.

title: Legions of Morgul
gametext:
To play, spot 2 [sauron] Orcs and add up to 3 threats.
Each time a companion is about to be killed, you may remove a threat to make all minions fierce until the regroup phase.
Discard this condition and remove 3 threats at the start of the regroup phase.

title: Mordor Defender

gametext: Skirmish: Exert this minion and spot another [sauron] minion to add a threat.

gametext: Skirmish: Remove 2 threats to make a [sauron] Orc strength +6.

title: Orc Archer Troop

Archer.

title: Orc Assault Band
gametext: Skirmish: Spot 6 companions and exert this minion to make another [sauron] Orc strength +6.

title: Orc Brood
gametext: Skirmish: Discard 3 cards from hand to make this minion strength +3.

title: Orc Butcher
gametext: For each [sauron] condition you can spot, this minion is strength +1.

title: Orc Chaser
gametext:
Tracker.

While you have initiative, this minion is strength +6.

title: Orc Destroyer
gametext: Shadow: Remove (3) and spot 3 [sauron] Orcs to draw a card.

title: Orc Fanatic
gametext: Skirmish: Discard this minion to make another [sauron] Orc strength +3.

title: Orc Marauder
gametext: While you can spot 3 other [sauron] Orcs, this minion is strength +5.

title: Orc Officer
gametext: Each time a companion is overwhelmed in a skirmish that involves a [sauron] Orc, add 3 burdens.

title: Orc Pursuer(2)

Tracker.

title: Orc Rager
gametext: Skirmish: Discard this minion to make another [sauron] Orc strength +4.

title: Orc Savage
gametext: While you can spot 6 companions and another [sauron] Orc, this minion is strength +9 and fierce.

title: Orc Seeker
gametext:
Tracker.
The site number of each [sauron] Orc is -1.
If you have initiative when you play this minion, you may spot another [sauron] Orc to draw 2 cards.

title: Orc Stalker
gametext:
Tracker.
The site number of each [sauron] Orc is -1.
While you have initiative, this minion is strength +8.

title: Rally the Host
gametext:
To play, spot 2 [sauron] Orcs.
Regroup: Exert a [sauron] Orc and remove a threat to shuffle a [sauron] Orc from play into your draw deck.

title: Rope and Winch
gametext:
To play, spot 2 [sauron] Orcs.
Discard any number of cards from hand. The Free Peoples player then discards any number of cards from hand. For each card you discarded more than the Free Peoples player, make a [sauron] Orc strength +2.

title: Sauron's Hatred
gametext:
To play, spot a [sauron] Orc.
Shadow: Remove a threat to play a [sauron] Orc without paying any roaming penalty.
Regroup: Spot a [sauron] Orc and remove (4) to add a threat.

Besieger.

gametext: If your [sauron] Orc wins a skirmish, make all your [sauron] Orcs fierce until the regroup phase.

title: Stronghold of Cirith Ungol
gametext:
Response: If your [sauron] minion wins a skirmish, place a [sauron] token here (limit 1 per site).

Regroup: Discard a besieger to take control of a site. Discard this condition.

title: Frodo

Ring-bearer (resistance 10). Ring-bound.

Each time the fellowship moves, add a threat or discard this condition.
Regroup: Discard this condition and exert a Hobbit companion to play the fellowship's next site (replacing opponent's site if necessary).

title: Sam
gametext:
Ring-bound.
Fellowship: Play a Hobbit companion to remove a burden.

title: Sam
gametext:
Ring-bound.

Response: If Frodo is killed, make Sam the Ring-bearer (resistance 5).

gametext:

Regroup: Discard this condition to discard a minion and remove 2 burdens.

gametext: When the fellowship moves from this site, the Free Peoples player may spot 3 Hobbits to remove (2).

gametext: Plains. Shadow: Exert a minion and spot 6 companions to add (1).

title: Ruined Capitol
gametext: River. Shadow: Spot your minion and 6 companions to make the move limit for this turn -1.

title: Cross Roads
gametext: Shadow: Spot 2 [raider] Men and remove a threat to add (2).

title: Morgul Vale
gametext: Skirmish: Spot your [sauron] minion and remove 2 threats to make your [sauron] minion strength +3.

title: Morgulduin
gametext: Shadow: Remove 2 threats to play a Nazgûl from your discard pile. His twilight cost is -2.

title: Northern Ithilien
gametext: Shadow: Remove 2 threats and play Gollum from your discard pile to add 2 burdens.

title: Dagorlad
gametext: Plains. When the fellowship moves to this site, add 3 threats.

title: Haunted Pass
gametext: Shadow: Remove a threat and spot your minion to draw a card.

title: Narchost
gametext: Shadow: Spot 8 burdens to make the Ring-bearer wear The One Ring until the regroup phase.

title: Slag Mounds
gametext: Each time a companion is killed, add a burden.

title: Aragorn
gametext:
While you cannot spot 4 threats, Aragorn is strength +1 for each threat.
Regroup: Exert Aragorn twice to remove 3 threats.
subtitle: Driven by Need

title: Éomer
gametext:
Valiant. While you can spot a [rohan] Man, Éomer's twilight cost is -1.
Skirmish: If you have initiative, discard 3 cards from hand to make Éomer strength +1 for each valiant companion you spot.
subtitle: Valiant Warchief

title: Aggression
gametext:
While you have initiative, each Dwarf is damage +1.
Fellowship: Spot a Dwarf who is damage +X to draw X cards. Discard this condition.

title: Battle in Earnest
gametext: Spot a Dwarf who is damage +X to place X wounds on minions.

title: Blood Runs Chill
gametext: Spot a Dwarf who is damage +X and exert that Dwarf twice to make an opponent discard X Shadow cards.

title: Counts But One
gametext: If Gimli is not assigned to a skirmish, add a threat to have him replace an unbound companion in a skirmish.

title: Gimli
gametext:
Damage +1.
For each wound on Gimli, he is strength +1 and damage +1.
subtitle: Counter of Foes

title: Honed
gametext: Spot a Dwarf who is damage +X to make him strength +X.

title: Unheard of
gametext: If a Dwarf who is damage +X wins a skirmish, wound a minion not assigned to a skirmish X times.

title: Wish For Our Kinfolk
gametext:
Fellowship: Exert a Dwarf companion and either an [elven] companion or a [gondor] Man to add a [dwarven] token here.
Skirmish: Remove a [dwarven] token here to make a companion damage +1.

title: A Grey Ship
gametext: Spot an Elf companion and make the fellowship archery total -X (to a minimum of 0) to heal X unbound companions. You cannot use archery special abilities.

title: Legolas
gametext:
Archer.
While you can spot 3 wounded minions, each minion skirmishing Legolas is strength -3.
subtitle: Elven Stalwart

title: Life of the Eldar
gametext:
To play, spot 2 Elves.
Discard an Elf to draw 3 cards.

title: Reckless We Rode
gametext: Exert an Elf companion and make the fellowship archery total -X (to a minimum of 0) to wound a minion X times. You cannot use archery special abilities.

title: Shake Off the Shadow
gametext:
Fellowship: Exert an Elf companion and either a [gandalf] companion or a [dwarven] companion to add an [elven] token here.
Archery: Remove an [elven] token here to make the fellowship archery total +1 (limit +2).

title: A Fool
gametext: At sites 1[K] to 5[K], heal Gandalf. At any other site, prevent a Hobbit from being overwhelmed unless his or her strength is tripled.

title: Gandalf
gametext: When Gandalf is in your starting fellowship, his twilight cost is -2.
subtitle: Leader of Men

title: Let Us Not Tarry
gametext: Exert Gandalf to make a minion skirmishing an unbound companion strength -1 for each Gandalf signet you spot.

title: Mighty Steed
gametext: If Gandalf is not assigned to a skirmish, spot Shadowfax or exert Gandalf to have Gandalf replace an unbound companion in a skirmish.

title: Not the First Halfling
gametext:
Fellowship: Exert Gandalf and either an [elven] companion or a [shire] companion to add a [gandalf] token here.
Skirmish: Remove a [gandalf] token here to make a minion skirmishing an unbound companion strength -2.

title: On Your Doorstep
gametext: Spot Gandalf and exert a companion to place a card of that companion's culture from your discard pile on top of your draw deck.

title: Saved From the Fire
gametext: Spot Gandalf and place a companion (except the Ring-bearer) in the dead pile to take up to 3 cards from that companion's culture into hand from your draw deck. Shuffle your draw deck.

title: Shadowfax
gametext:
Bearer must be Gandalf.
At the start of each skirmish involving Gandalf, each minion skirmishing Gandalf must exert.
Skirmish: Add a threat to make Gandalf strength +1.
subtitle: Greatheart

title: Hidden Even From Her
gametext:
Gollum is fierce.
Shadow: Spot 6 companions to play Gollum from your discard pile and exert a companion. Place this condition on top of your draw deck.

title: Larder
gametext:
To play, spot a [gollum] minion.
Regroup: Discard an Orc from hand to add a [gollum] token here.
Skirmish: Remove a [gollum] token here to make Shelob strength +3 (limit +6).

title: Promise Keeping
gametext: Each time a companion takes a wound during a skirmish that involves a [gollum] minion, exert a companion.

title: Shelob
gametext:
Fierce.
When you play Shelob, you may play a [gollum] possession from your draw deck.
Shelob is strength +3 for each minion stacked on a [gollum] possession.
subtitle: Eater of Light

title: Shelob
gametext:
Enduring. Fierce.
While in a fierce skirmish, Shelob is damage +1.
subtitle: Last Child of Ungoliant

title: Sméagol
gametext:
Ring-bound. To play, add a burden.
Skirmish: Add threats equal to the total vitality of the minions Sméagol is skirmishing to discard Sméagol.
Regroup: Discard Sméagol to take a [gollum] minion from your discard pile into hand.
subtitle: Slippery Sneak

title: Spider Poison
gametext:
Skirmish: Remove a threat or a burden to transfer this possession to a companion skirmishing Shelob.
Each time bearer is assigned to a skirmish, bearer must exert.

title: Still Far Ahead
gametext: Spot Sméagol to play the fellowship's next site (replacing opponent's site if necessary). The Shadow number of the fellowship's next site is -1 until the end of the turn.

title: Web
gametext:
Regroup: If there are fewer than 3 cards stacked here, spot your Orc or [gollum] minion to stack that minion here.
Shadow: Play a [gollum] minion stacked here as if played from hand.

title: At His Command
gametext: Exert Aragorn to make an unbound companion with the Aragorn signet strength +1 for each threat you spot.

title: Catapult
gametext:
To play, spot 2 [gondor] knights.
Maneuver: Discard 2 cards from hand to reveal the top card of an opponent's draw deck. Choose an opponent who must discard a Shadow card that has a twilight cost that is the same as the twilight cost of the revealed card.

title: Elessar's Edict
gametext: If a [gondor] Wraith is about to be killed, discard him and either exhaust another [gondor] Wraith or spot another exhausted [gondor] Wraith to prevent that.

title: Faramir
gametext:
Knight.
When you play Faramir (except in your starting fellowship), you may reveal the top 10 cards of your draw deck. You may play a knight revealed. Shuffle your draw deck.
subtitle: Defender of Osgiliath

title: Fourth Level
gametext:
Fortification.
Skirmish: Exert 2 [gondor] Men or spot 3 knights to transfer this condition from your support area to a minion skirmishing a [gondor] Man. Exhaust that minion.

title: Garrison of Gondor
gametext:
Knight. Archer.
To play, spot 3 [gondor] companions.
While you can spot a fortification, Garrison of Gondor is defender +1.

title: Imrahil
gametext:
Knight. To play, spot a knight.
Each time Imrahil wins a skirmish, you may exert 2 minions.
subtitle: Prince of Dol Amroth

title: King of the Dead
gametext:
Enduring. To play, spot a [gondor] Wraith and add 2 threats.
Response: If Aragorn is about to take a wound in a skirmish, exert King of the Dead to prevent that wound.
subtitle: Oathbreaker

title: Knight of Dol Amroth
gametext:
Knight.
Each time this companion wins a skirmish, you may wound a minion he is skirmishing.

title: Knight's Mount
gametext:
Bearer must be a knight.
Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may wound a minion who is not assigned to a skirmish.

title: Oathbreaker
gametext:
Enduring. To play, add a threat.
Skirmish: Discard 3 cards from hand to discard a possession borne by a minion skirmishing this companion.

title: A Path Appointed
gametext:
Fellowship: Exert a [gondor] Man and either a [dwarven] companion or a [rohan] companion to add a [gondor] token here.
Regroup: Remove a [gondor] token here to discard a minion.

title: Shadow Host
gametext:
Enduring. To play, spot 2 exhausted [gondor] Wraiths and add 2 threats.
While Shadow Host is exhausted, it is defender +1.

title: Sixth Level
gametext:
Fortification.
Regroup: Exert a [gondor] Man to play a [gondor] fortification from your discard pile (limit 1).

title: Sleepless Dead
gametext:
Enduring. To play, add a threat.
Each time this companion wins a skirmish, you may exert him to discard a minion he is skirmishing.

title: Spectral Sword
gametext:
Bearer must be a [gondor] Wraith.
Skirmish: Discard 3 cards from hand to heal bearer.

title: Stronger and More Terrible
gametext:
To play, add a threat.
Each time your [gondor] Wraith wins a skirmish, you may remove a threat.

title: Swept Away
gametext:
Each time the fellowship moves, add a threat or discard this condition.
While you have initiative, exhausted [gondor] Wraiths cannot take wounds.

title: Black Númenorean
gametext:
Corsair. Fierce.
Skirmish: If you have initiative, remove a [raider] token to discard a possession borne by a character skirmishing this minion.

title: Black Sails of Umbar
gametext:
When you play this possession, you may add a [raider] token here.
Shadow: Remove X [raider] tokens here to play a corsair from your discard pile; its twilight cost is -X. Discard this possession.

title: Castamir of Umbar
gametext:
Corsair. Enduring. Fierce.
Shadow: Exert Castamir of Umbar and play a corsair to add 2 [raider] tokens to a card that already has a [raider] token on it.

title: Corsair Ballista
gametext:
Bearer must be a corsair.
While you have initiative, bearer is an archer and fierce.

title: Corsair Buccaneer
gametext:
Corsair.
When you play this minion, you may remove a threat to add 2 [raider] tokens to a card that already has a [raider] token on it.

title: Corsair Freebooter
gametext:
Corsair.
When you play this minion, you may remove 2 culture tokens to add 2 [raider] tokens to a card that already has a [raider] token on it.

title: Corsair Gunners
gametext:
Corsair.
Skirmish: If you have initiative, remove a [raider] token to make a corsair fierce until the regroup phase.

title: Corsair Lookout
gametext:
Corsair.
When you play this minion, if you have initiative, you may discard an ally to add 2 [raider] tokens to a card that already has a [raider] token on it.

title: Corsair Marauder
gametext:
Corsair.
When you play this minion, if you can spot another corsair, you may discard a possession to add 2 [raider] tokens to a card that already has a [raider] token on it.

title: Corsair Plunderer
gametext:
Corsair.
When you play this minion, you may discard 2 cards from hand to add 2 [raider] tokens to a card that already has a [raider] token on it.

title: Corsair War Galley
gametext:
When you play this possession, you may add a [raider] token here.
While you can spot 6 [raider] tokens and a [raider] Man, the Shadow has initiative, regardless of the Free Peoples player's hand.
Regroup: Add (1) for each [raider] token you can spot. Discard this possession.

title: Haradrim Marksman
gametext:
Southron. Archer.
While you can spot another [raider] Man, Ring-bound companions cannot take archery wounds.

title: Haradwaith
gametext:
While you can spot a [raider] minion at site 4[K], the Shadow has initiative, regardless of the Free Peoples player's hand.
Response: If a companion is played, discard a [raider] card from hand to add (5). Discard this condition.

title: Heavy Axeman
gametext:
Easterling.
While you can spot 4 burdens, Heavy Axeman is strength +4 and fierce.

title: Line of Defense
gametext: While you can spot a mounted [raider] Man, [raider] Men cannot take wounds (except during skirmishes).

title: Mûmakil
gametext:
Bearer must be a Southron.
Bearer is fierce.
While you have initiative or can spot 4 threats, bearer is damage +1.

title: Ships of Great Draught
gametext:
Shadow: Remove a threat or discard a [raider] card from hand to add a [raider] token here.
Regroup: Remove 2 [raider] tokens here to place a [raider] card from your discard pile on top of your draw deck.

title: Wind That Sped Ships
gametext: Make a corsair strength +1 for each [raider] token you spot (limit +6). If you have initiative, you may place this event on top of your draw deck.

title: Between Nazgûl and Prey
gametext: Exert an enduring [wraith] minion twice to assign that minion to an unbound companion.

title: Beyond All Darkness
gametext: Exert a Nazgûl to make him strength +2 and damage +1. If the character he is skirmishing is killed, the Free Peoples player must place his or her hand beneath his or her draw deck.

title: Black Dart
gametext:
Archery: Spot your enduring or mounted Nazgûl to transfer this condition from your support area to an unbound companion. Discard a mount borne by that companion.
Bearer cannot heal or bear mounts.

title: Black Flail
gametext:
Bearer must be a Nazgûl.
Skirmish: If bearer is The Witch-king, exert him and spot a possession borne by a character he is skirmishing to discard that possession.

title: Flung Into the Fray
gametext:
When you play a minion stacked here, you may exert a companion.
Regroup: If no minion is stacked here, spot your [wraith] minion to stack it here.
Shadow: Spot 2 [wraith] minions to play a [wraith] minion stacked here as if played from hand.

title: Gothmog
gametext: While you have initiative, each [wraith] minion is an archer.
subtitle: Morgul Commander

title: Mastered By Madness
gametext: Make a Nazgûl strength +2. If that Nazgûl wins this skirmish, you may discard a Free Peoples mount.

title: Morgul Ambusher
gametext: While you can spot 3 threats, the minion archery total is +2.

title: Morgul Creeper
gametext: While you can spot 3 burdens, the minion archery total is +2.

title: Morgul Lurker
gametext: While you have initiative, the minion archery total is +2.

title: Morgul Squealer
gametext:
Shadow: Discard this minion to play a [wraith] minion from your discard pile.
Shadow: Spot 6 companions and discard this minion to play up to 2 [wraith] minions from your draw deck; their twilight costs are each -1.

title: Streaming to the Field
gametext:
For each [wraith] Orc you can spot, the Free Peoples player must have an additional card in hand to have initiative.
Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a [wraith] Orc strength +2.

title: Úlairë Attëa
gametext:
Enduring.
Regroup: Exert Úlairë Attëa and spot your [wraith] minion to return that minion to your hand.
subtitle: Thrall of The One

title: Úlairë Nertëa
gametext:
Enduring. Fierce.
The site number of each [wraith] minion is -1.
subtitle: Thrall of The One

title: Úlairë Otsëa
gametext:
Enduring. Fierce.
Regroup: Discard Úlairë Otsëa to add (X), where X is the current site number.
subtitle: Thrall of The One

title: Unhindered
gametext: Make a Nazgûl strength +2. If that Nazgûl wins this skirmish, the Shadow has initiative until the end of the turn, regardless of the Free Peoples player's hand.

title: Winged Mount
gametext:
To play, discard 2 cards from hand. Bearer must be a Nazgûl.
Response: If bearer is about to take a wound, remove a threat to prevent that wound.

title: The Witch-king
gametext:
Enduring.
Each Man skirmishing The Witch-king loses all strength bonuses from weapons.
subtitle: Black Captain

title: Charged Headlong
gametext: If you have initiative, discard a [rohan] possession to play a [rohan] possession from your discard pile.

title: Doom Drove Them
gametext:
Fellowship: Exert a [rohan] companion and either a [gondor] Man or a [shire] companion to add a [rohan] token here.
Skirmish: Remove a [rohan] token here to exert a minion skirmishing a companion.

title: Éomer
gametext:
Valiant.
When you play Éomer (except in your starting fellowship), you may reveal the top 10 cards of your draw deck. You may play each [rohan] possession revealed. Shuffle your draw deck.
subtitle: Keeper of Oaths

title: Éowyn's Shield
gametext:
Bearer must be a [rohan] Man.
The minion archery total is -1.
Skirmish: If bearer is Éowyn, add a threat and discard Éowyn's Shield to discard a hand weapon borne by a minion she is skirmishing.

title: Fury of the Northmen
gametext: Exert a minion skirmishing a mounted [rohan] Man.

title: No Living Man
gametext: Exert Théoden to exert a minion for each Théoden signet you spot.

title: Rohirrim Army
gametext:
To play, spot 3 [rohan] companions.
You may play Rohirrim Army any time you could play a regroup event.
When you play Rohirrim Army, you may discard a minion.

title: Théoden
gametext:
Valiant.
While you can spot a [rohan] Man, Théoden's twilight cost is -1.
When Théoden is killed, you may play a [rohan] companion from your discard pile or draw deck.
subtitle: Tall and Proud

title: Called Away
gametext: Regroup: Discard a [sauron] minion, spot a companion (except the Ring-bearer), and remove X burdens, where X is that companion's vitality, to return that companion to its owner's hand.

title: Gorgoroth Agitator
gametext:
Besieger. To play, spot a [sauron] Orc.
When you play this minion, if you can spot another besieger, you may add a threat for each companion over 4.
Shadow: Remove a threat to play a [sauron] engine from your discard pile.

title: Gorgoroth Assassin
gametext:
Besieger.
Assignment: Spot a [sauron] engine or a site you control to assign this minion to an unbound companion.

title: Gorgoroth Berserker
gametext:
Besieger. Enduring. To play, spot a [sauron] Orc.
Maneuver: If you have initiative, exert this minion twice to take control of a site.
Maneuver: Remove a threat and exert this minion twice to take control of a site.

title: Gorgoroth Breaker
gametext:
Besieger.
Archery: Exert this minion or stack it on a site you control to make the fellowship archery total -2.

title: Gorgoroth Looter
gametext:
Besieger.
When you play this minion, you may remove a burden to play a besieger stacked on a site you control.

title: Gorgoroth Patrol
gametext:
Besieger.
Regroup: If this minion is stacked on a site you control, discard this minion to make the move limit for this turn -1.

title: Gorgoroth Servitor
gametext:
Besieger.
Archery: Return this minion to your hand to make the fellowship archery total -2 and prevent the Free Peoples player from using archery special abilities.

title: Gorgoroth Stormer
gametext:
Besieger.
Shadow: If you have initiative, exert this minion to add a burden and make the Free Peoples player draw a card.

title: Great Hill Troll
gametext:
Besieger. Fierce.
The twilight cost of this minion is -1 for each [sauron] engine you spot.
When you play this minion at sites 5[K] to 9[K], you may discard a Free Peoples condition.

title: Grond
gametext:
Engine.
Shadow: Play a [sauron] minion to add a [sauron] token here.
Regroup: Remove X [sauron] tokens here to discard a Free Peoples card (except a companion) with a twilight cost of X. Discard a [sauron] minion or this possession.
subtitle: Hammer of the Underworld

title: Morgai
gametext:
While you can spot a [sauron] minion at site 5[K], the Shadow has initiative, regardless of the Free Peoples player's hand.
Response: If a companion is played, discard a [sauron] card from hand to take control of a site. Discard this condition.

title: Olog-hai of Mordor
gametext:
Besieger. Fierce.
The twilight cost of this minion is -2 for each [sauron] minion stacked on a site.
Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may play a besieger stacked on a site you control. That besieger is fierce and damage +1 until the regroup phase.

title: Siege Troop
gametext:
Besieger.
Regroup: Exert this minion twice to take control of a site.

title: Their Marching Companies
gametext:
Engine. To play, spot a [sauron] minion.
Regroup: Remove a threat to stack your [sauron] minion on a site you control.
Shadow: Remove a threat to play a [sauron] minion stacked on a site you control.

title: Troll of Gorgoroth
gametext:
Besieger. Fierce. To play, spot a [sauron] Orc.
The twilight cost of Troll of Gorgoroth is -2 for each [sauron] engine you spot.
Regroup: Exert Troll of Gorgoroth to stack your besieger on a site you control.
subtitle: Abomination of Sauron

title: Closer and Closer He Bent
gametext: Regroup: Exert an unbound Hobbit and add a burden to reveal your hand. Place each Free Peoples card revealed this way beneath your draw deck.

title: Morgai Foothills
gametext:
When the fellowship moves from site 4[K], remove (1) for each Ring-bound companion you spot.
Regroup: Discard a card from hand for each Ring-bound companion you spot. Discard this condition.

title: So Fair, So Desperate
gametext: If the Shadow has initiative, add a threat to make an unbound Hobbit strength +1 for each [shire] card you spot.

title: Song of the Shire
gametext:
Fellowship: Exert a [shire] companion and either a [rohan] companion or a [gandalf] companion to add a [shire] token here.
Skirmish: Remove a [shire] token here to prevent an unbound companion from being overwhelmed unless his or her strength is tripled.

title: Sting
gametext:
Bearer must be Frodo or Sam.
Response: If a fierce skirmish involving bearer is about to end, add a threat to discard a minion involved in that skirmish.
subtitle: Bane of the Eight Legs

title: Straining Towards Us
gametext: Exert Frodo to remove (1) for each Frodo signet you spot.

title: Unheeded
gametext: If a minion exerts, exert an unbound Hobbit to wound that minion.

title: We Shall Meet Again Soon
gametext: If the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, exert an unbound Hobbit to place a Shadow card from your discard pile on top of your draw deck.

title: The Dimholt
gametext: Underground. Sanctuary. Fellowship: Add 3 threats to play an enduring companion from your draw deck.

title: City of the Dead
gametext: Underground. Shadow: Remove 2 burdens to play an enduring minion from your draw deck or discard pile.

title: Crashed Gate
gametext: At the start of the regroup phase, the Free Peoples player must add 3 threats or choose an opponent who may take control of a site.

title: Osgiliath Channel
gametext: River. Regroup: Spot your minion and 6 companions to make the Free Peoples player choose to move again this turn.

title: Merry
gametext:
To play, spot a [rohan] companion.
Skirmish: Discard 4 cards from hand to make Merry strength +2 for each [rohan] companion you spot.
subtitle: Noble Warrior

title: Pippin
gametext:
To play, spot a [gondor] Man.
Skirmish: Discard 4 cards from hand to wound a minion Pippin is skirmishing twice if that minion bears a fortification.
subtitle: Guard of Minas Tirith

title: The One Ring
gametext:
Fellowship: Add 2 burdens to play a ring from your draw deck.
Maneuver: Exert bearer to wear The One Ring until the regroup phase.
While wearing The One Ring, each time the Ring-bearer is about to take a wound, add a burden instead.
subtitle: The Binding Ring

title: Freca
gametext:
When you play Freca, you may spot another [dunland] Man to take control of a site.
When Freca is killed, the Free Peoples player may liberate a site.
subtitle: Hungry Savage

title: Durin III
gametext:
Damage +1.
While you can spot 2 Dwarves, Durin III is twilight cost -2.
Durin III is strength +1 for each artifact and each possession he bears.
subtitle: Dwarven Lord

title: Gimli
gametext:
Damage +1.
While Gimli is the Ring-bearer, at the start of each skirmish involving him, add 2 burdens or 2 threats.
While Gimli is damage +X, he is resistance +X.
subtitle: Bearer of Grudges

title: Linnar
gametext:
Each time a Dwarf wins a fierce skirmish, you may heal that Dwarf.
Skirmish: Discard a [dwarven] card from hand to make a Dwarf damage +1.
subtitle: Dwarven Lord

title: Ring of Accretion
gametext:
Bearer must be a Dwarf.
Bearer is damage +1.
Maneuver: For each Dwarf you spot, reveal a card from the top of your draw deck. Take all Free Peoples cards revealed into hand and discard the rest. Discard this artifact.

title: Ring of Fury
gametext:
Bearer must be a Dwarf.
Bearer is damage +2.
Regroup: Spot a Dwarf that is damage +X to heal X Dwarves. Discard this artifact.

title: Ring of Guile
gametext:
Bearer must be a Dwarf.
Bearer is damage +1.
Maneuver: Take a [dwarven] event into hand from your discard pile. Discard this artifact.

title: Ring of Retribution
gametext:
Bearer must be a Dwarf.
Response: If bearer wins a skirmish, discard this artifact to exert each Orc.

title: Sindri
gametext: You may play [dwarven] skirmish events stacked on [dwarven] conditions as if from hand.
subtitle: Dwarven Lord

title: Úri
gametext: Skirmish: If Úri is damage +X, exert him to make him strength +X.
subtitle: Dwarven Lord

title: Aiglos
gametext:
Bearer must be an Elf.
If bearer is Gil-galad, he is strength +1 for each [elven] artifact you can spot (limit +6).
Regroup: Discard Aiglos to wound a minion for each Elf you spot.

title: Elven Rope
gametext:
To play, spot an Elf. Bearer must be an Elf or Hobbit.
Maneuver: Discard this possession to make a Shadow player return a minion with strength 6 or less to its owner's hand.

title: Galadriel
gametext: While Galadriel bears an artifact or The One Ring, she is resistance +1 for each [elven] companion you can spot.
subtitle: Bearer of Wisdom

title: Gil-galad
gametext:
To play, spot 2 [elven] companions.
Regroup: Exert Gil-galad to wound each wounded minion.
subtitle: Elven High King

title: Glorfindel
gametext:
When Glorfindel is in your starting fellowship, his twilight cost is -2.
Skirmish: Reveal the top card of your draw deck. You may exert Glorfindel to make a Nazgûl he is skirmishing strength -X, where X is the twilight cost of the card revealed.
subtitle: Revealed in Wrath

title: Knife of the Galadhrim
gametext:
Bearer must be a [gondor] Man. If bearer is Aragorn, he may bear this hand weapon in addition to 1 other hand weapon.
Skirmish: Discard this weapon to wound a minion bearer is skirmishing.

title: Merry's Dagger
gametext:
Bearer must be Merry.
Skirmish: Exert Merry twice or discard this possession to wound a minion he is skirmishing. Any Shadow player may remove (1) to prevent this.

title: Narya
gametext:
Bearer must be Círdan or Gandalf.
Fellowship: Remove X culture tokens, where X is equal to bearer's vitality. Discard this artifact.
subtitle: Ring of Fire

title: Nenya
gametext:
Bearer must be Galadriel.
Maneuver: Heal 2 companions and place up to 2 cards from your hand on top of your draw deck. Discard this artifact.
subtitle: Ring of Adamant

title: Pippin's Dagger
gametext:
Bearer must be Pippin.
Skirmish: Exert Pippin twice or discard this possession to wound a minion an Elf is skirmishing. Any Shadow player may remove (1) to prevent this.

title: Strands of Elven Hair
gametext:
To play, spot a Dwarf.
When you play this possession, add 2 [elven] tokens here.
Fellowship: Discard this possession or remove an [elven] token from here to reveal the top card of your draw deck. If it is a [dwarven] or [elven] card, you may take it into hand.

title: Vilya
gametext:
Bearer must be Elrond or Gil-galad.
Skirmish: Discard the top card of your draw deck. Make a minion skirmishing an Elf strength -X, where X is the twilight cost of the discarded card. Discard this artifact.
subtitle: Ring of Air

title: Ent Draught
gametext:
To play, spot an Ent. Bearer must be a companion. Limit 1 per bearer.
Skirmish: Exert bearer to make him or her damage +1.

title: Huorn
gametext:
Damage +1.
This companion is strength +1 for each Ent you can spot.
Response: If this companion is about to take a wound, exert an Ent to prevent that.

title: Radagast
gametext:
The move limit is +1.
Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, each opponent may discard 2 cards from hand to draw 2 cards.
subtitle: The Brown

title: Sent Back
gametext:
Skirmish: Discard this condition to discard each minion skirmishing a Wizard. Place that Wizard in your dead pile.
Fellowship or Regroup: Play a Wizard (even if another copy of that Wizard is in your dead pile).

title: Gollum
gametext:
Shadow: Exert Gollum twice to exert the Ring-bearer.
Shadow: Remove a burden to add (1).
Skirmish: Remove a burden to add (2).
Regroup: Remove a burden to add (3).
Regroup: Exert Gollum twice to wound the Ring-bearer.
subtitle: Dark as Darkness

title: Slippery as Fishes
gametext:
While Gollum is at a mountain, river, or underground site, he is strength +2.
Regroup: Spot Gollum to reveal your hand. Place all Shadow cards revealed beneath your draw deck. Discard this condition.

title: Sméagol
gametext:
Ring-bound. To play, add a burden.
Each time the fellowship moves, place an unbound companion in the dead pile.
Regroup: If Sméagol is the Ring-bearer, add 2 burdens to discard each minion.
subtitle: Bearer of Great Secrets

title: Boromir
gametext:
While Boromir is the Ring-bearer, at the start of each skirmish involving him, add 3 burdens or wound him twice.
Each time Boromir wins a skirmish, discard each minion he is skirmishing.
subtitle: Bearer of Council

title: Elendil
gametext:
To play, spot 2 [gondor] Men.
Fellowship: Play an artifact on Elendil to make the move limit +1 for this turn.
Regroup: Discard a [gondor] artifact to liberate a site.
subtitle: The Tall

title: Isildur
gametext:
While Isildur is the Ring-bearer, at the start of each skirmish involving him, add 2 burdens or exert 3 companions.
While Isildur bears The One Ring or an artifact, each [gondor] knight is strength +1.
subtitle: Bearer of Heirlooms

title: Narsil
gametext:
Bearer must be a [gondor] Man.
If bearer is Elendil or Isildur, he is strength +1 for each [gondor] artifact you can spot (limit +6).
Response: If bearer is about to take a wound, exert 2 [gondor] Men to prevent that.
subtitle: Blade of the Faithful

title: Sapling of the White Tree
gametext:
To play, spot an unbound [gondor] Man.
Response: If a [gondor] Man is about to take a wound, discard this artifact to prevent that.

title: Scroll of Isildur
gametext:
Tale. To play, spot a [gondor] Man.
The Ring-bearer is resistance +1 for each [gondor] artifact you can spot (limit +3).
Fellowship: Discard this artifact to play a ring from your discard pile.

title: Seeing Stone of Minas Anor
gametext:
To play, spot a [gondor] Man with 3 or more vitality (or spot a [gondor] Man and add 2 threats).
Regroup: Exert a [gondor] Man or discard this artifact to discard your hand and draw 3 cards.

title: Seeing Stone of Orthanc
gametext:
To play, spot a [gondor] Man with 3 or more vitality (or spot a [gondor] Man and add 2 threats).
Regroup: Add a threat or discard this artifact to remove (2) or to draw a card.

title: Library of Orthanc
gametext:
Shadow: Play an [isengard] minion to stack the top card of your draw deck on this card.
Skirmish: Remove (1) and discard a Free Peoples card stacked here to make an [isengard] minion strength +1.
Regroup: Remove (1) to take an [isengard] card stacked here into hand.

title: Sack of the Shire
gametext: If an [isengard] minion wins a skirmish, until the regroup phase, make that minion strength +1 for each site you control and fierce.

title: Host of Moria
gametext: When you play Host of Moria, you may play a [moria] card from your discard pile.
subtitle: Legion of the Underdeeps

title: Ring of Asperity
gametext:
Bearer must be a Nazgûl.
When you play this artifact, you may wound an unwounded companion.
Response: If a player reconciles, return bearer to his owner's hand.

title: Ring of Ire
gametext:
Bearer must be The Witch-king.
Skirmish: Exert bearer twice to make a [wraith] minion damage +1.
Response: If a player reconciles, return bearer to his owner's hand.

title: Ring of Rancor
gametext:
Bearer must be a Nazgûl.
Maneuver: Remove a burden to heal each Nazgûl.
Response: If a player reconciles, return bearer to his owner's hand.

title: Horn of the Mark
gametext:
Bearer must be Merry or Pippin.
Bearer gains the Théoden signet.
Response: If bearer wins a skirmish, exert him to discard each minion involved in that skirmish.

title: The Red Arrow
gametext: Assignment: Exert a [gondor] Man to play a [rohan] Man. You may exert that [rohan] Man to play a possession on him or her. Discard this artifact.

title: Ithil Stone
gametext:
To play, exert a [wraith] or [sauron] minion.
At the start of each of your Shadow phases, you may draw a card.
Shadow: Discard this artifact to play a [sauron] minion. Its twilight cost is -3.

title: Sauron
gametext:
Damage +2. Enduring. Fierce.
For each burden you spot, threat you spot, and site you control, Sauron's twilight cost is -1.
subtitle: The Lord of the Rings

title: Bilbo
gametext:
Ring-bound.
Each time the fellowship moves, if the twilight pool has 2 or fewer twilight tokens, add 2 burdens or add (3).
Regroup: Add a burden to play a [shire] tale.
subtitle: Bearer of Things Burgled

title: Everyone Knows
gametext:
Tale. Each unbound Hobbit is strength +1 for each vitality over 3 he or she has.
Skirmish: Prevent an unbound Hobbit from being overwhelmed unless his or her strength is tripled. Discard this condition.

title: Goldberry
gametext:
Each time the fellowship moves to a river, heal Goldberry and Tom Bombadil.
Skirmish: If the fellowship is at a river, exert Goldberry to make a companion strength +1.
subtitle: River-daughter

title: Tom Bombadil
gametext:
To play, remove 2 burdens or 2 threats.
Skirmish: Spot 2 [shire] companions and exert Tom Bombadil X times, where X is the fellowship's site number, to cancel a skirmish involving a [shire] companion.
subtitle: The Master

title: Great Day, Great Hour
gametext: If an opponent plays a minion, exert a Dwarf who is damage +X to exert that minion X times.

title: Memories of Darkness
gametext:
To play, spot a Dwarf.
Each time you lose initiative (except during the fellowship phase), you may play a [dwarven] condition from hand or from your discard pile.

title: More Yet to Come
gametext: If a Dwarf kills a minion in a skirmish and that minion did not take all wounds caused by that Dwarf's damage bonus, assign those remaining wounds to minions not assigned to a skirmish.

title: Aegnor
gametext: Skirmish: Exert Aegnor to make a minion skirmishing an unbound [elven] companion strength -1 for each archer you spot.
subtitle: Elven Escort

title: Arwen
gametext: Skirmish: Discard a card from hand to discard the bottom card of your draw deck. If the bottom card was an [elven] card, each minion skirmishing Arwen is strength -3.
subtitle: Echo of Lúthien

title: Arwen
gametext: Each minion skirmishing Arwen is strength -2 for each wounded minion you can spot.
subtitle: Queen of Elves and Men

title: Celeborn
gametext: At the start of each skirmish involving Celeborn, you may reveal the top card of your draw deck. If it is an [elven] card, you may discard it to wound each minion in that skirmish.
subtitle: Lord of the Galadhrim

title: Círdan
gametext:
To play, spot 2 Elves.
Skirmish: Exert Círdan to make a minion he is skirmishing strength -1 for each [elven] event in your discard pile.
subtitle: The Shipwright

title: Elrond
gametext:
To play, spot an Elf.
At the start of each skirmish involving Elrond, you may reveal the top card of your draw deck. If it is an [elven] card, you may heal another Elf.
subtitle: Venerable Lord

title: Fleet-footed
gametext: Make a minion skirmishing an Elf strength -2. Spot a site in a support area to place this event on top of your draw deck.

title: Galadriel
gametext:
When Galadriel is in your starting fellowship, her twilight cost is -3.
Fellowship or Regroup: Discard an [elven] event from hand to discard a Shadow condition or Shadow possession.
subtitle: Lady Redeemed

title: Glimpse of Fate
gametext:
To play, spot 2 Elves.
Each time you lose initiative, make a minion strength -4 until the regroup phase.

title: Phial of Galadriel
gametext:
Bearer must be a Hobbit.
Skirmish: Until the regroup phase, remove the game text (except card type and race) from a minion skirmishing bearer and make it unable to gain game text. Discard this artifact.
subtitle: Star-glass

title: Borne Far Away
gametext: Spot your Wizard to exchange a companion in hand with a companion in your dead pile or discard pile.

title: Brooding on Tomorrow
gametext: Each time you lose initiative (except during the fellowship phase), you may spot a [gandalf] companion to choose an opponent who must discard one of his or her conditions.

title: Gathering Wind
gametext: Exert your Wizard to choose a number. Make each minion with that twilight cost strength -2 until the regroup phase.

title: Out of the High Airs
gametext: If the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, exert your Wizard to discard each minion.

title: Treebeard
gametext:
To play, spot 3 [gandalf] companions.
Regroup: Exert Treebeard twice to play a [gandalf] condition from your discard pile and make an opponent discard one of his or her conditions.
subtitle: Keeper of the Watchwood
