gametext: If an opponent plays a possession on a companion, play Gollum at twilight cost -2 from your discard pile or hand to suspend the current phase. Begin a skirmish phase involving Gollum and that companion. When it ends, resume the suspended phase.

title: Final Strike
gametext:
Any site 9 is a mountain.
Shadow: If the fellowship is at any site 9, play Gollum from your discard pile.
Response: If the Free Peoples player uses a maneuver or archery special ability, exert Gollum to cancel its effect.

title: Gollum
gametext: To assign Gollum to a skirmish, the Free Peoples player must make Gollum strength +3 until the regroup phase or add a burden.
subtitle: Mad Thing

title: Reclaim the Precious
gametext:
Assignment: Assign Gollum to a companion bearing an artifact. The Free Peoples player may add a burden to prevent this and assign Gollum.
Regroup: Exert Gollum twice to discard a possession. Discard this condition.

title: Shelob
gametext:
Enduring. Fierce.
When you play Shelob, if you can spot Gollum, you may spot a companion. That companion cannot be assigned to a skirmish until the end of the turn.
subtitle: Her Ladyship

title: Unabated in Malice
gametext:
While you have initiative, each [gollum] minion is damage +1.
Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a [gollum] minion strength +1 for each culture you can spot.

title: Aragorn
gametext:
When you play Aragorn, you may heal another companion.
At the start of each fellowship phase, you may exert a companion of one culture to heal a companion of another culture.
subtitle: Elessar Telcontar

title: Cursed of Erech
gametext:
Enduring. To play, add a threat.
When you play Cursed of Erech, exert him twice.
At the start of the maneuver phase, you may exert another [gondor] Wraith to make Cursed of Erech defender +1 until the regroup phase.

title: Dead Man of Dunharrow
gametext:
Enduring. To play, add a threat.
When you play this companion, exert him twice.

title: Denethor
gametext:
To play, spot 2 [gondor] Men.
Fellowship: If at a sanctuary, exert Denethor to take a [gondor] card into hand from your draw deck, then reshuffle. Choose an opponent who may draw 2 cards.
subtitle: Lord of Minas Tirith

title: Drawing His Eye
gametext: For each [gondor] companion you spot, reveal 1 card at random from a Shadow player's hand. Choose a revealed Shadow card to be discarded, then its owner draws a card.

title: End of the Game
gametext: Make an exhausted [gondor] companion strength +2. If that companion wins this skirmish, heal that companion or make him or her damage +1.

title: Every Little is a Gain
gametext: Spot a [gondor] Man to discard a stacked Shadow card or to wound a minion bearing a fortification.

title: Fifth Level
gametext:
Fortification. Bearer is strength -1 for each fortification you can spot.
Maneuver: Exert 2 [gondor] Men or spot 3 knights to transfer this condition to a minion.

title: Hardy Garrison
gametext:
To play, spot 2 [gondor] Men.
Each time you lose initiative, you may wound a minion.

title: Last Throw
gametext: If no opponent controls a site, spot 2 [gondor] Men to make the move limit +1 for this turn.

title: Suffered Much Loss
gametext:
Each site on the adventure path is a battleground.
While you have initiative, each Uruk-hai is strength +1.

title: Cast Unto the Winds
gametext: Regroup: Spot a Southron, remove a threat, and remove (3) to wound an unbound companion.

title: Corsair Boatswain
gametext:
Corsair. To play, spot a [raider] Man.
Shadow: Exert this minion to play a [raider] support area possession from your draw deck.

title: Corsair Brute
gametext:
Corsair.
At the start of each skirmish involving this minion, you may remove a [raider] token to wound a companion he is skirmishing.

title: Corsair Ruffian
gametext:
Corsair.
When you play this minion, you may spot another corsair and discard the top card of the Free Peoples player's draw deck to add 2 [raider] tokens to a card that already has a [raider] token on it.

title: Easterling Berserker
gametext:
Easterling. To play, spot an Easterling.
While this minion is unwounded, he is damage +2.
Skirmish: Wound 2 other [raider] Men to heal this minion.

title: Easterling Pillager
gametext:
Easterling. Fierce.
When you play this minion, you may spot another Easterling to add a burden for each companion over 5.

title: Far Harad Mercenaries
gametext:
Southron.
At the start of each skirmish involving this minion, you may spot 6 companions and another [raider] Man to discard an unbound companion this minion is skirmishing.

title: Field of the Fallen
gametext:
To play, spot a [raider] Man.
While there is a character in the dead pile, each companion of the same culture as that character is strength -1.
Skirmish: Exert your Southron to make him strength +1.

title: High Vantage
gametext: Until the end of the assignment phase, each time a Southron is about to take a wound, prevent that.

title: Mûmak Chieftain
gametext:
Southron.
When you play this minion, you may play a mount on him from your discard pile. Its twilight cost is -2.

title: Quelled
gametext: Exert a [raider] Man to discard a Free Peoples condition. If you spot a [rohan] Man, discard an additional Free Peoples condition.

title: Rallying Call
gametext:
To play, spot a [raider] Man.
Threats cannot be removed by Free Peoples cards.
Shadow: Remove (1) and play a Southron to add a threat.

title: Seasoned Leader
gametext:
Bearer must be a Southron.
Bearer is enduring.
Skirmish: Remove a threat to play a [raider] condition from your discard pile.

title: Southron Fanatic
gametext:
Southron.
Each time a Man is assigned to skirmish this minion, wound that Man.

title: Southron Savage
gametext:
Southron.
While the total number of other minions and twilight tokens is 3 or fewer, this minion is strength +3 and fierce.

title: Stampeded
gametext: If a Free Peoples possession is played, spot a [raider] card to discard that possession. If that possession was a [gondor] or [rohan] possession, wound an unbound Man.

title: Under Foot
gametext:
Shadow: If you have initiative, spot a [raider] Man and discard this condition to reconcile your hand.
Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a [raider] Man strength +2.

title: Black Marshal
gametext: Shadow: Exert a Nazgûl and play a [wraith] minion to add (1) (or (2) if you have initiative).

title: Cirith Ungol Scavenger
gametext: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may exert it to discard a possession borne by a character this minion is skirmishing.

title: Cirith Ungol Soldier
gametext: Shadow: Spot a possession to make this minion fierce until the regroup phase.

title: Cirith Ungol Warrior
gametext: Shadow: Spot a possession to make this minion fierce until the regroup phase.

title: Cirith Ungol Watchman
gametext: Each companion skirmishing this minion loses all damage and strength bonuses from possessions.

title: Dark Swooping Shadows
gametext: Heal an enduring [wraith] minion to add a burden or 2 threats.

title: Gorbag
gametext: For each wound on the Ring-bearer, each [wraith] Orc is strength +1.
subtitle: Covetous Captain

title: Gorbag's Sword
gametext:
Bearer must be a [wraith] Orc.
When you play this possession, you may discard a possession. Its owner may place it on top of his or her draw deck instead.
If bearer is Gorbag, he is fierce.

title: Houses of Lamentation
gametext: Make a [wraith] minion strength +2 (or +4 if skirmishing a companion of the same culture as a card in the dead pile).

title: Morgul Banner-bearer
gametext: While the total number of other minions and twilight tokens is 3 or fewer, this minion is strength +3 and an archer.

title: Morgul Vanguard
gametext: Assignment: Assign this minion to an unbound companion bearing a hand weapon.

title: Stooping to the Kill
gametext:
While you have initiative, each of your [wraith] minions is damage +1.
Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a [wraith] minion strength +2.

title: Swarming Like Beetles
gametext: Maneuver: Spot a [wraith] Orc and remove a threat to wound an unwounded companion.

title: Ten Times Outnumbered
gametext: Make a [wraith] Orc strength +2 for each wound on the Ring-bearer.

title: Úlairë Cantëa
gametext:
Enduring. Fierce.
Shadow cards cannot exert Úlairë Cantëa during a skirmish phase.
Skirmish: Heal Úlairë Cantëa to discard a possession borne by a character he is skirmishing.
subtitle: Thrall of The One

title: Úlairë Enquëa
gametext:
Enduring.
Shadow cards cannot exert Úlairë Enquëa during a skirmish phase.
Skirmish: If Úlairë Enqueä is skirmishing, heal him to add a burden.
subtitle: Thrall of The One

title: Úlairë Lemenya
gametext:
Enduring. Fierce.
Shadow cards cannot exert Úlairë Lemenya during a skirmish phase.
Skirmish: Heal Úlairë Lemenya to wound up to 3 other [wraith] minions.
subtitle: Thrall of The One

title: Úlairë Nelya
gametext:
Enduring. Fierce.
Shadow cards cannot exert Úlairë Nelya during a skirmish phase.
Skirmish: Heal Úlairë Nelya to add (1) for each burden.
subtitle: Thrall of The One

title: Úlairë Toldëa
gametext:
Enduring.
Shadow cards cannot exert Úlairë Toldëa during a skirmish phase.
Skirmish: Heal Úlairë Toldëa to make him damage +1.
subtitle: Thrall of The One

title: Éowyn
gametext: Skirmish: Exert Éowyn to choose an opponent. That opponent must wound a minion for each wound on each minion skirmishing Éowyn.
subtitle: Lady of Ithilien

title: Fell Deeds Awake
gametext:
To play, spot a [rohan] Man.
Each time you lose initiative, you may liberate a site.

title: Unyielding
gametext: If your [rohan] Man wins a skirmish, discard a [rohan] possession to wound a minion or to liberate a site.

title: Advance Captain
gametext: Each roaming [sauron] minion is damage +1.

title: Advance Marauder
gametext: Skirmish: Exert this minion to make a roaming [sauron] minion strength +3.

title: Advance Regular
gametext: Each roaming [sauron] minion is fierce.

title: Advance Scout
gametext: Shadow: Exert or discard this minion to make each [sauron] minion you spot roaming until the regroup phase.

title: Barren Land
gametext:
To play, spot a [sauron] minion.
Each time the fellowship moves to any site 8 or 9, exert each Ring-bound companion.
Shadow: Discard this condition to play a [sauron] minion. Its twilight cost is -2.

title: Beaten Back
gametext: Make a [sauron] minion strength +2 for each site you control. If you have initiative, that minion is fierce until the regroup phase.

title: Cirith Ungol Guard
gametext: Damage +1.

title: Cirith Ungol Patroller
gametext:
Damage +1.
While you can spot 3 possessions, this minion is fierce.

title: Cirith Ungol Sentinel
gametext:
Damage +1.
If you can spot another [sauron] Uruk-hai, this minion is twilight cost -1 for each possession you can spot.

title: Cirith Ungol Sentry
gametext: Damage +1.

title: Flames Within
gametext:
While you have initiative, each of your [sauron] minions is strength +2.
Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a [sauron] minion strength +2 (or +4 if it is roaming).

title: Gorgoroth Keeper
gametext:
Besieger.
While you control a site, this minion's twilight cost is -2.
Regroup: Stack this minion on a site you control.

title: Gorgoroth Swarm
gametext:
Besieger.
When you play this minion, you may spot 6 companions and another besieger to play a besieger from your discard pile and control a site.

title: Gothmog
gametext:
Besieger.
When you play Gothmog, the Free Peoples player must wound a companion for each site you control.
While you control a site, Gothmog is fierce.
subtitle: Lieutenant of Morgul

title: Gothmog's Warg
gametext:
Bearer must be a [sauron] Orc.
For each site you control, bearer is strength +1 (or +2 if bearer is Gothmog).

title: Mordor Brute
gametext: Each [sauron] Orc bearing a possession cannot take wounds (except during skirmish phases).

title: Mordor Fiend
gametext: Shadow: If you cannot spot another minion and there are 3 or fewer twilight tokens, add (3) (or (5) if this minion is roaming).

title: Mordor Pillager
gametext:
Besieger. Fierce.

gametext:
Bearer must be a Nazgûl.
While bearer is at a battleground or forest site, he is strength +1.

title: Sauron's Gaze
gametext:
Skirmish: Transfer this condition from your support area to a character skirmishing a Nazgûl.
The Free Peoples player cannot use bearer's special abilities.

title: Sense of Obligation
gametext:
To play, spot a [wraith] minion. Bearer must be an unbound companion. Limit 1 per bearer.
At the end of each assignment phase, if bearer is not assigned to a skirmish and a companion who does not bear a [wraith] condition is, add a burden.

title: Shadowy Mount
gametext:
Bearer must be a Nazgûl.
While bearer is at a battleground or forest site, he is fierce.
Assignment: Make the Free Peoples player assign bearer to an unbound companion bearing a [wraith] condition.

title: Steed of Mordor
gametext:
Bearer must be a Nazgûl.
Bearer gains muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.)
Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may draw 2 cards.

title: Úlairë Attëa
gametext:
Fierce.
Skirmish: Remove (2) and discard a [wraith] card from hand to make Úlairë Attëa strength +3.
subtitle: Black Predator

title: Úlairë Cantëa
gametext:
Fierce.
Assignment: Assign Úlairë Cantëa to a companion who has resistance 0.
Skirmish: Spot 6 companions and another [wraith] card to kill a companion Úlairë Cantëa is skirmishing.
subtitle: Black Assassin

title: Úlairë Enquëa
gametext:
Fierce. Toil 1. (For each [wraith] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -1.)
Response: If you are playing a [wraith] event that has toil X, exert Úlairë Enquëa to reduce that event's twilight cost by X.
subtitle: Black Threat

title: Úlairë Lemenya
gametext: When you play Úlairë Lemenya, you may play a [wraith] mount from your discard pile.
subtitle: Black Enemy

title: Úlairë Nelya
gametext:
Fierce.
Each time Úlairë Nelya wins a skirmish, you may draw a card.
subtitle: Black Hunter

title: Úlairë Nertëa
gametext:
The twilight cost of each mount is -1.
While Úlairë Nertëa is mounted, each Nazgûl is strength +1 and has muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.)
subtitle: Black Horseman

title: Úlairë Otsëa
gametext: Shadow: Exert Úlairë Otsëa and discard a [wraith] condition from hand to discard a Free Peoples condition from play.
subtitle: Black Specter

title: Úlairë Toldëa
gametext:
Fierce.
When you play Úlairë Toldëa, you may exert him to take a [wraith] event from your discard pile into hand.
subtitle: Black Shadow

title: Unending Life
gametext:
While you can spot 6 companions, each Nazgûl is strength +3.
Skirmish: Discard this condition to heal a Nazgûl.

title: Unimpeded
gametext: Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a Nazgûl strength +1 for each of the following that is true: he is at a battleground or forest site; he is skirmishing a companion who has resistance 4 or less; he is bearing a possession; he is in a fierce skirmish.

title: The Witch-king
gametext:
Fierce.
The Witch-king is twilight cost -1 for each wound on the Ring-bearer.
Each time a companion is played, you may reveal this card from hand to exert the Ring-bearer.
subtitle: Black Lord

title: The Witch-king's Beast
gametext:
Bearer must be a Nazgûl.
If bearer is The Witch-king, after all skirmishes and fierce skirmishes have been resolved, you may exert him twice to make him participate in one additional assignment and skirmish phase.
subtitle: Fell Creature

title: The Angle
gametext: Forest. Shadow: Play a Nazgûl (or spot 6 companions and discard 2 cards from hand) to draw a card.

title: The Bridge of Khazad-dûm
gametext: Battleground. Underground. The Balrog is twilight cost -3.

title: Emyn Muil
gametext: Mountain. Maneuver: Remove (2) and exert your minion that is not fierce to make that minion fierce until the regroup phase.

title: Hill of Sight
gametext: Battleground. Forest. While you can spot 3 minions (or 6 companions), each unbound companion is resistance -2.

title: Hobbiton Market
gametext: Dwelling. When the fellowship moves from this site, wound each minion that is not a lurker.

title: Northern Pelennor
gametext: Battleground. Plains. Shadow: Make your lurker minion lose lurker until the regroup phase.

title: Shores of Nen Hithoel
gametext: River. Shadow: Spot 5 [orc] Orcs to prevent the fellowship from moving again this turn.

title: Slopes of Orodruin
gametext: Mountain. Shadow: Remove (2) and discard 2 Free Peoples cards from hand to draw a card.

title: Starkhorn
gametext: Mountain. Each time your Dwarf wins a skirmish, you may draw a card.

title: Wold Battlefield
gametext: Plains. Skirmish: Exert your Man (except an enduring Man) to make him or her damage +1.

title: Arod
gametext:
Bearer must be a Dwarf.
When you play Arod, you may reinforce a [dwarven] token.
Response: If bearer is about to take a wound during a skirmish, remove 2 [dwarven] tokens to prevent that.
subtitle: Rohirrim Steed

title: Awkward Moment
gametext: Make a Dwarf strength +3 (or +4 and damage +1 if you can spot a [dwarven] token).

title: Deep Hatred
gametext:
Each time the fellowship moves, add (2).
Skirmish: Exert a Dwarf who is not assigned to a skirmish to wound 2 Orcs (or to wound 1 Orc twice).
Discard this from play if the fellowship is ahead on the adventure path.

title: Dwarf-lords
gametext:
You may remove from the game 4 other [dwarven] cards in your discard pile to play this event from your discard pile. Then remove this event from the game.
Make your Dwarf bearing a hand weapon strength +3.

title: Gimli
gametext:
Damage +1.
Gimli is strength +1 for each minion assigned to a skirmish.
Assignment: Exert Gimli and spot a lurker minion to make that minion lose lurker until the regroup phase.
subtitle: Lord of the Glittering Caves

title: Honoring His Kinfolk
gametext: If a Dwarf wins a fierce skirmish, play a [dwarven] possession from your discard pile and you may reinforce a [dwarven] token.

title: Sorrow Shared
gametext: Remove a [dwarven] token to heal a Dwarf.

title: Subterranean Homestead
gametext:
To play, exert 2 Dwarves.
When you play this, add a [dwarven] token here for each mountain site and each underground site on the adventure path.
Skirmish: Discard this from play or remove 2 tokens from here to make a Shadow player discard the top card of his or her draw deck.

title: Arwen
gametext:
While the fellowship is at a forest site, each of your other [elven] companions is resistance +1.
Skirmish: Exert Arwen to make a minion she is skirmishing strength -1 for each other companion assigned to a skirmish.
subtitle: Reflection of Lúthien

title: Asfaloth
gametext:
Bearer must be an Elf.
When you play Asfaloth, you may reinforce an [elven] token.
Skirmish: Remove 2 [elven] tokens to heal bearer (or heal bearer and heal another Elf if bearer is in a fierce skirmish).
subtitle: Swift Blossom

title: Celeborn
gametext:
While the fellowship is at a forest site, each Elf who has resistance 7 or more gains muster.
Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, you may take an [elven] event into hand from your discard pile.
subtitle: The Wise

title: City of the Trees
gametext:
At the end of your turn, discard this from play if the fellowship did not move more than once this turn.
At the start of each skirmish involving an Elf and a wounded minion, you may draw a card.

title: Crashing Cavalry
gametext: Assignment: Discard this from play and assign a minion to an [elven] companion. Those characters cannot use skirmish special abilities until the start of the regroup phase.

title: Final Shot
gametext: Make an [elven] companion strength +2 (or +5 if the fellowship has moved more than once this turn).

title: Galadriel
gametext:
To play, spot 3 Elves.
Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, you may reveal a card from the top of your draw deck for each forest on the adventure path to heal an Elf for each [elven] card revealed.
subtitle: Sorceress of the Hidden Land

title: Inside a Song
gametext: Exert an Elf to take an [elven] skirmish event into hand from your discard pile and you may reinforce an [elven] token.

title: Kindreds Estranged
gametext:
You may remove from the game 4 other [elven] cards in your discard pile to play this event from your discard pile. Then remove this event from the game.
Make a minion skirmishing your Elf at a forest or river site strength -3.

title: Legolas
gametext:
Archer.
At the start of each archery phase, you may reveal the top card of your draw deck. If it is an [elven] card, wound a minion.
subtitle: Of the Grey Company

title: Let Fly
gametext: Spot 3 Elves, spot a Shadow race, and choose a Shadow player to wound each of that player's minions which is not of that race.

title: Lórien Protector
gametext: While another companion is assigned to a skirmish, during each skirmish, prevent all wounds to this companion after the first wound.

title: Many Miles
gametext: Spot 2 Elf archers to make the fellowship archery total +1 (or +2 if a Shadow player has replaced the fellowship's current site this turn).

title: Secluded Homestead
gametext:
To play, spot 2 Elves.
When you play this, add an [elven] token here for each forest site and each river site on the adventure path.
Regroup: Discard this from play or remove 2 tokens from here to reconcile your hand.

title: Shrouded Elf
gametext: Response: If you play an event during a skirmish involving this companion, exert this companion to place that event on top of your draw deck.

title: Spring Forth Nimbly
gametext: Make an Elf strength +1 for each card that has an [elven] token on it.

title: Standing Tall
gametext: Skirmish: Discard this condition from play to make a minion skirmishing an Elf strength -1 for each of the following that is true: it is skirmishing a companion who has resistance 4 or more; it is wounded; you can spot an Elf archer; the fellowship is at a forest site.

title: Take Up the Bow
gametext:
Toil 2. (For each [elven] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.)
Archery: Discard this from play and spot 3 Elf archers to discard a minion from play. Each of those archers loses archer and cannot gain archer.

title: Wells of Deep Memory
gametext:
At the end of your turn, discard this from play if the fellowship did not move more than once this turn.
Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, you may draw a card for each of the following you can spot: Arwen, Celeborn, or Galadriel.

title: Alatar
gametext:
Aid – (2). (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add (2) to transfer this to a companion.)
Each time you transfer this to a companion, you may reinforce a [gandalf] token.
While you can spot a [gandalf] companion, each minion skirmishing bearer is strength -1.
subtitle: Final Envoy

title: Dasron
gametext: At the start of the fellowship phase, you may remove 2 Free Peoples culture tokens to take a [gandalf] event into hand from your discard pile.
subtitle: Merchant From Dorwinion

title: Fear and Great Wonder
gametext:
When you play this, add a [gandalf] token here.
Maneuver: Discard this from play or remove a token from here to spot a [gandalf] companion. That companion gains muster until end of turn.

title: The Flame of Anor
gametext:
Spell.
Spot 3 [gandalf] companions to make a minion skirmishing a companion strength -3.

title: For a While Less Dark
gametext:
Spell.
Make a [gandalf] companion strength +2 (or +4 if that companion bears a follower).

title: Gandalf
gametext: While Gandalf is the Ring-bearer, each time the fellowship moves, add 3 burdens unless you spot 2 other companions and discard 2 [gandalf] cards from hand.
subtitle: Bearer of Obligation

title: Look to My Coming
gametext:
You may remove from the game 4 other [gandalf] cards in your discard pile to play this event from your discard pile. Then remove this event from the game.
Spot Gandalf to make your [gandalf] companion strength +3.

title: No Colour Now
gametext: Discard your [gandalf] condition from play to discard a condition from play and draw a card.

title: The Palantír of Orthanc
gametext:
Bearer must be Gandalf. To play this, if you can spot The Palantír of Orthanc, discard it.
At the start of the fellowship phase, you may add a burden to reveal a Shadow player's hand. He or she must choose a revealed minion and discard it from hand.
subtitle: Recovered Seeing Stone

title: Pallando
gametext:
Aid – (2).
Each time you transfer this to a companion, except a [gandalf] companion, exert bearer twice.
Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may discard a condition from play.
subtitle: Far-travelling One

title: Radagast
gametext:
Aid – (2). (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add (2) to transfer this to a companion.)
While you can spot 2 [gandalf] companions, minions skirmishing bearer do not gain strength bonuses from possessions.
subtitle: Tender of Beasts

title: Return to Us
gametext: Discard 2 Shadow cards from hand to take a [gandalf] event into hand from your discard pile.

title: Shadowfax
gametext:
Bearer must be a Wizard.
When you play Shadowfax, you may reinforce a [gandalf] token.
Skirmish: Remove 2 [gandalf] tokens to wound a minion skirmishing bearer.
subtitle: Roaring Wind

title: Strange Meeting
gametext: Each companion bearing a follower gains muster (and is strength +1 if that companion is a [gandalf] companion).

title: Traveler's Homestead
gametext:
To play, spot a Wizard.
When you play this, add X [gandalf] tokens here, where X is the current region number.
Maneuver: Discard this from play or remove 2 tokens from here to discard a Shadow condition from play.

title: Vapour and Steam
gametext: Skirmish: Exert your [gandalf] companion and add a burden to make that companion damage +1.

title: Chasm's Edge
gametext: Gollum is strength +1 for each Ring-bound companion you can spot.

title: Cunningly Hidden
gametext:
You may remove from the game 4 [gollum] cards in your discard pile instead of paying the twilight cost for this card.
Spot Gollum to make a minion strength +2.

title: Déagol
gametext:
To play, spot Sméagol.
Aid – Add a burden.
Skirmish: If bearer is not assigned to a skirmish, discard this from play to play an artifact or possession from your draw deck on bearer.
subtitle: Fateful Finder

title: Duality
gametext: Spot Sméagol to choose a Shadow player who must discard a Shadow card from hand or remove (2).

title: Fishing Boat
gametext:
Bearer must be Sméagol.
When you play Fishing Boat, you may reinforce a [gollum] token.
Each time Sméagol is about to be overwhelmed in a skirmish, you may remove 2 [gollum] tokens to make him strength +2 until the end of that skirmish.

title: Gladden Homestead
gametext:
To play, spot Sméagol.
When you play this, add a [gollum] token here for each [gollum] card you can spot.
Maneuver: Discard this from play or remove 2 tokens from here to spot a Shadow condition and place that condition on top of its owner's draw deck.

title: Gollum
gametext:
While a card titled Déagol is removed from the game, Gollum is strength +2 and fierce.
Shadow: Remove a card titled Déagol in your discard pile from the game to play this minion from your discard pile.
subtitle: Her Sneak

title: It's My Birthday
gametext: Make Gollum strength +2 (or +4 if you can spot Sméagol or Déagol).

title: Little Snuffler
gametext:
If the fellowship is in region 1, spot Gollum to wound a companion.
If the fellowship is in region 2, spot Gollum to exert a companion.
If the fellowship is in region 3, play a [gollum] minion from your discard pile.

title: Naked Waste
gametext:
You may remove from the game 4 other [gollum] cards in your discard pile to play this event from your discard pile. Then remove this event from the game.
Spot Sméagol to make a Ring-bound companion strength +3.

title: Out of All Knowledge
gametext: Spot Sméagol or exert Gollum to make Sméagol strength +2 and you may reinforce a [gollum] token.

title: Sméagol
gametext:
Ring-bound. To play, add a burden.
For each card titled Déagol in your discard pile, Sméagol is strength +2 and resistance -1.
Each time Sméagol wins a skirmish, you may take a [gollum] card from your draw deck and place it in your discard pile.
subtitle: Simple Stoor

title: Softly Up Behind
gametext:
Spot Sméagol and discard 2 [gollum] cards from hand to return a minion with strength 6 or less to its owner's hand.
While this is in your discard pile, Sméagol gains muster.

title: Trap Is Sprung
gametext:
To play, discard Gollum from play.
Heal the Ring-bearer to add a burden. If the fellowship is not in region 1, you may repeat this for each other wound on the Ring-bearer.

title: Wild Light of Madness
gametext: Spot Gollum to make the Free Peoples player choose to either add a burden or exert a companion.

title: Aragorn
gametext:
Aragorn is strength +1 for each [gondor] card that has a culture token on it.
At the start of each assignment phase, you may exert Aragorn to make an unbound companion that has resistance 7 or more defender +1 until the regroup phase.
subtitle: Isildur's Heir

title: Away on the Wind
gametext: Response: If Faramir is about to take a wound, discard this condition from play and place Boromir or Denethor in the dead pile from play to prevent that and heal Faramir twice.

title: Banners Blowing
gametext:
You may remove from the game 4 other [gondor] cards in your discard pile to play this event from your discard pile. Then remove this event from the game.
Make your [gondor] Man strength +3.

title: Boromir
gametext:
Boromir is resistance -1 for each lurker minion you can spot.
Skirmish: Exert Boromir to make him strength +1 for each possession he bears.
subtitle: Doomed Heir

title: Brego
gametext:
Bearer must be a [gondor] companion.
When you play Brego, you may reinforce a [gondor] token.
Maneuver: Exert bearer and remove 2 [gondor] tokens to wound a minion.
subtitle: Loyal Steed

title: Denethor
gametext:
Denethor is resistance +1 for each [gondor] possession in your discard pile.
Maneuver: Spot a [gondor] possession borne by a companion and remove that possession from the game to exert a minion twice.
subtitle: Last Ruling Steward

title: Elendil
gametext:
Knight. To play, spot 2 [gondor] knights or exert 2 [gondor] Men.
Each of your [gondor] companions is resistance +1.
Maneuver: Remove a [gondor] token to make an unbound companion resistance +1 until the regroup phase.
subtitle: High-king of Gondor

title: Faramir
gametext:
While you can spot Boromir, Faramir is twilight cost -1.
While you can spot Denethor, Faramir is twilight cost -1.
While Faramir bears a [gondor] possession, he is defender +1.
subtitle: Prince of Ithilien

title: Guard of the White Tree
gametext:
Knight.
Skirmish: Discard a [gondor] condition from your support area to make this companion strength +2.

title: Guarded City
gametext: Spot a [gondor] companion to reinforce a [gondor] token for each possession borne by that companion.

title: Heirs of Gondor
gametext:
When you play this, add a [gondor] token here.
Skirmish: Discard this from play or remove a token from here to make a [gondor] companion bearing a hand weapon strength +2.

title: Hope Renewed
gametext: Discard a [gondor] possession from play to discard a possession from play and you may reinforce a [gondor] token.

title: Isildur
gametext:
Knight.
Isildur is resistance +1 for each card in your hand.
At the end of any phase, if Isildur has resistance 0, place him in your dead pile.
Each time you reconcile, you may draw a card.
subtitle: Heir of Elendil

title: Kings' Legacy
gametext:
Each time Elendil wins a skirmish, make a [gondor] or [elven] companion strength +2 until the start of the regroup phase.
Each time Isildur wins a skirmish, heal a Man.
Each time Aragorn wins a skirmish, make a [gondor] Man damage +1 until the start of the regroup phase.

title: Kingsfoil
gametext:
Bearer must be a [gondor] Man.
Fellowship: Discard this possession from play to heal a companion and, if that companion is a [shire] companion, you may discard a condition he or she bears.

title: Rally the Company
gametext: Make a [gondor] companion strength +2 (or +4 if that companion has resistance 6 or more).

title: Stewards' Legacy
gametext:
Each time Denethor exerts, he gains muster until the end of the regroup phase.
Each time Boromir exerts, you may exert a minion.
Each time Faramir exerts, you may spot a minion to prevent it from using special abilities until the regroup phase.

title: Storied Homestead
gametext:
When you play this, add a [gondor] token here for each [gondor] companion who has resistance 7 or more.
Response: If a minion's special ability is used, discard this condition or remove 2 [gondor] tokens from here to cancel its effect.

title: Tradesman From Lebennin
gametext: At the start of each fellowship phase, you may add (2) to reinforce a [gondor] token.

title: Alatar Deceived
gametext: Each time a Wizard wins a skirmish, this condition becomes a fierce, damage +1 Wizard minion until the start of the regroup phase that has 11 strength and 1 vitality, and cannot take wounds or bear other cards. This card is still a condition.

title: Pallando Deceived
gametext: At the start of the maneuver phase, you may exert a Wizard to make this condition a fierce Wizard minion until the start of the regroup phase that has 10 strength and 1 vitality, and cannot take wounds or bear other cards. This card is still a condition.

title: Radagast Deceived
gametext: Each time a Wizard heals, this condition becomes a fierce Wizard minion until the start of the regroup phase that has 12 strength and 1 vitality, and cannot take wounds or bear other cards. This card is still a condition.

title: Staff of Saruman
gametext:
Bearer must be a Wizard.
Regroup: If Saruman is the only minion you can spot, discard this artifact from play to return him to your hand.
subtitle: Fallen Istar's Stave

title: Bring Down the Wall
gametext: Spot a companion to make a [men] minion strength +1 for each wound on that companion.

title: Caravan From the South
gametext:
To play, spot a [men] minion.
When you play this, if you spot a plains site on the adventure path, reinforce 3 [men] tokens.
Each time the Free Peoples player plays the fellowship's next site, you may discard a possession from play.

title: Corsair Champion
gametext:
Each time a Free Peoples possession is played, you may spot a [men] card and reveal this minion from hand to make the Free Peoples player exert a companion.
While each companion is wounded, this minion is fierce.

title: Cruel Dunlending
gametext: Skirmish: If this minion is not assigned to a skirmish, you may exert him to make another [men] minion fierce until the regroup phase.

title: Desert Wind
gametext:
To play, spot a [men] minion.
While you can spot 5 or more culture tokens, the minion archery total is +2.

title: Driven From the Plains
gametext: Skirmish: Discard this condition from play to make a [men] minion damage +1 for each of the following that is true: it is at a plains site; it is bearing a possession; it is skirmishing a companion who has resistance 4 or less.

title: Dunlending Patriarch
gametext:
When you play this, you may spot another [men] minion to make this minion twilight cost -1 for each wound on the Ring-bearer.
While each companion is wounded, this minion is fierce.

title: Dunlending Trapper
gametext:
Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.)
To play, spot a [men] minion.
Assignment: Discard a [men] card from your hand to assign this minion to an unbound companion.

title: Easterling Runner
gametext: Shadow: Exert this minion, spot another [men] minion, and remove a culture token to reinforce a [men] token.

title: Fires Brightly Burning
gametext:
You may remove from the game 4 [men] cards in your discard pile instead of paying the twilight cost for this card.
Make your [men] minion strength +2.

title: Gríma
gametext:
Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.)
Each time a Free Peoples character is killed, you may spot another [men] minion to exert each companion.
subtitle: Footman of Saruman

title: Harmless
gametext:
Response: If a companion loses a skirmish involving a [men] minion, transfer this condition from your support area to that companion. Limit 1 per companion.
Minions cannot take wounds during skirmishes involving bearer.

title: Howdah
gametext:
When you play this, add a [men] token here for each [men] archer you spot.
At the start of the archery phase, you may discard this condition from play or remove 2 tokens from here to make the minion archery total +1.

title: Lying in Wait
gametext:
Skirmish: Transfer this condition from your support area to your [men] minion. Limit 1 per bearer.
Bearer is strength +1 for each other [men] minion you can spot.
Each time a [men] minion wins a skirmish, make bearer strength +1 until the regroup phase.

title: Merciless Dunlending
gametext: While you can spot another [men] minion, this minion is strength +2 for each companion assigned to a skirmish.

title: Pirate Cutthroat
gametext:
To play, spot a [men] card in your support area.
Shadow: Exert this minion and spot a Free Peoples condition to reinforce a [men] token for each card you spot that has the same card title as that condition.

title: Southron Murderer
gametext:
Archer.
While you can spot 4 or more culture tokens, this minion cannot take wounds except during skirmishes.

title: Stragglers
gametext:
When you play this, add a [men] token here.
Skirmish: Discard this from play or remove a token from here to make a [men] minion strength +2 for each [men] minion not assigned to a skirmish.

title: Vicious Dunlending
gametext: Skirmish: If this minion is not assigned to a skirmish, you may exert him to make another [men] minion damage +1.

title: Voice of the Desert
gametext:
To play, spot a [men] minion.
While the fellowship is in region 1, each [men] minion cannot take wounds.
While the fellowship is in region 2, each [men] minion is an archer.
While the fellowship is in region 3, each [men] minion is fierce.
subtitle: Southron Troop

title: Worn Battleaxe
gametext:
Bearer must be a [men] minion.
While you can spot a culture token, bearer is strength +1 for each companion assigned to a skirmish.

title: Always Threatening
gametext:
When you play this, you may add an [orc] token here for each [orc] condition you can spot.
Skirmish: Discard this from play or remove 2 tokens from here to make a lurker minion strength +2.

title: Chamber Patrol
gametext:
To play, spot an [orc] minion.
While the fellowship is in region 1, [orc] Orcs cannot take wounds.
While the fellowship is in region 2, the current site gains underground.
While the fellowship is in region 3, each [orc] Orc is strength +2.

title: Defiled
gametext:
You may remove from the game 4 [orc] cards in your discard pile instead of paying the twilight cost for this card.
Make your [orc] lurker minion strength +2.

title: Enemy Upon Enemy
gametext:
Regroup: Spot an [orc] lurker minion to stack that minion here.
Shadow: Remove a burden to play a lurker minion stacked here as if from hand. That minion is twilight cost -3.

title: Expendable Servants
gametext: If you can spot more [orc] conditions than [orc] minions, you may discard your [orc] condition from play to play an [orc] minion from your discard pile.

title: Forced March
gametext:
To play, spot 2 [orc] minions.
Regroup: Make the Free Peoples player spot another [orc] condition, discard it from play, and remove (3) to make the Free Peoples player choose to move again this turn (if the move limit allows). Discard this condition.

title: Howling Orc
gametext:
Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.)
Each time an [orc] minion is killed in a skirmish, you may make this minion strength +2 until the regroup phase.

title: Isengard Informant
gametext: Regroup: Exert this minion to play an [orc] Troll from your discard pile.

title: Massing Strength
gametext: Discard any number of your [orc] minions from play to make an [orc] minion strength +3 for each one discarded.

title: Orc Crusher
gametext:
To play, spot an [orc] Orc.
This minion is twilight cost -1 for each burden.
Each time a Ring-bound companion loses a skirmish involving an [orc] minion, you may reveal this card from hand to add a burden.

title: Orc Line-breaker
gametext: At the end of each skirmish involving this minion, if you can spot a Free Peoples culture token, this minion is fierce until the regroup phase.

title: Orc Plains Runner
gametext: Regroup: Discard this minion from play (or exert this minion if the fellowship's next site is an underground site) and spot another [orc] minion to return that minion to your hand.

title: Orc Raid Commander
gametext:
To play, spot an [orc] card in your support area.
When you play this, spot a Free Peoples condition to discard from play each other card that has the same card title as that condition.

title: Orc Reaper
gametext: While you can spot a Free Peoples culture token, each minion that has the title Orc Reaper is strength +2.

title: Ordnance Grunt
gametext:
Damage +1. Fierce. To play, spot an [orc] minion.
Shadow: Discard an [orc] condition from play to play this minion from your discard pile.

title: Picket Denizen
gametext:
Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.)
Response: If another [orc] minion is about to take a wound, exert this minion to prevent that.

title: Underdeeps Denizen
gametext: While this minion is at an underground site, it cannot take wounds.

title: Unforgiving Depths
gametext:
While you can spot 3 underground sites, each [orc] Orc gains muster.
Shadow: Discard this condition from play and spot an [orc] minion to replace the fellowship's current site with an underground site from your adventure deck.

title: Whatever Means
gametext: Make an [orc] Orc strength +2 (or +6 if you remove 2 burdens).

title: Bitter Tidings
gametext:
If Théoden is about to take a wound in a skirmish, you may discard from play Éomer or Théodred to prevent that.
If Théodred is about to take a wound in a skirmish, you may discard from play Éomer or Éowyn to prevent that.

title: Éomer
gametext:
While Éomer bears a mount, he is damage +1.
While no other companion is assigned to a skirmish, Éomer is strength +1 for each other [rohan] companion you can spot.
subtitle: Heir to Meduseld

title: Éowyn
gametext:
Each possession you play on Éowyn during the fellowship phase is twilight cost -1.
Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, you may reinforce a [rohan] token (or reinforce 2 [rohan] tokens if you can spot Éomer or Théoden).
subtitle: Restless Warrior

title: Ferthu Théoden Hal
gametext:
To play, spot 2 [rohan] Men.
Unless you can spot a companion who has resistance 3 or less, discard a possession from play.

title: Firefoot
gametext:
Bearer must be a [rohan] Man.
When you play Firefoot, you may reinforce a [rohan] token.
At the start of the maneuver phase, if bearer is Éomer, you may remove 2 [rohan] tokens to make him defender +1 and strength +1 until the regroup phase.
subtitle: Mearas of The Mark

title: Freely Across Our Land
gametext:
When you play this, add a [rohan] token here.
Regroup: Discard this from play or remove a token from here to play a [rohan] possession from your discard pile on your [rohan] companion.

title: Háma
gametext:
Háma is strength +1 for each Shadow possession you can spot.
Each time Háma wins a skirmish, you may discard a possession from play.
subtitle: Captain of the King's Guard

title: Hamstrung
gametext: Make a [rohan] companion strength +2 (or +5 if the fellowship has moved twice this turn).

title: Hurried Barrows
gametext:
You may remove from the game 4 other [rohan] cards in your discard pile to play this event from your discard pile. Then remove this event from the game.
Make your mounted [rohan] companion strength +3.

title: King's Board
gametext:
Skirmish: Exert Éomer to make Éowyn or Théoden strength +2.
Skirmish: Exert Éowyn to make Éomer or Théoden strength +2.
Skirmish: Exert Théoden to make Éomer or Éowyn strength +2.

title: Merchant of Westfold
gametext: Each time the fellowship moves, you may add (1) and remove a Free Peoples culture token to reinforce a [rohan] token.

title: Riddermark Tactician
gametext:
When you play this, you may reinforce a [rohan] token.
Each time a Shadow player replaces the fellowship's current site, you may spot another [rohan] Man to make, until the regroup phase, the fellowship archery total +2 and the minion archery total -2.

title: Ride With Me
gametext: Make your [rohan] companion strength +2 (or exert Théoden to make that companion strength +5 and damage +1 instead).

title: Rider's Bow
gametext:
Bearer must be a [rohan] Man.
If bearer is mounted, he or she is strength +1.
Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may choose a Shadow player who must wound one of his or her minions.

title: Snowmane
gametext:
Bearer must be a [rohan] Man.
When you play Snowmane, you may reinforce a [rohan] token.
Skirmish: If bearer is Théoden, you may remove 2 [rohan] tokens to exhaust a minion he is skirmishing.
subtitle: Noble Mearas

title: Théoden
gametext:
While you can spot Éowyn, Théoden is defender +1.
While you can spot Éomer, Théoden is damage +1.
While you can spot Théodred, the move limit is +1.
subtitle: The Renowned

title: Théodred
gametext:
While you can spot a [rohan] Man who has resistance of 7 or more, Théodred is twilight cost -1.
At the start of each skirmish involving Théodred, you may exert each minion he is skirmishing.
subtitle: Second Marshal of the Mark

title: Wind-swept Homestead
gametext:
To play, spot 2 [rohan] companions.
When you play this, add a [rohan] token here for each plains site and each battleground site on the adventure path.
At the start of each regroup phase, add a [rohan] token here for each of your companions that has muster.

title: Sauron
gametext:
Damage +1. Fierce.
When you play Sauron, you may exert any number of minions. For each minion you exert, Sauron is twilight cost -X, where X is the current region number.
subtitle: Dark Lord of Mordor

title: Sceptre of the Dark Lord
gametext:
Bearer must be Sauron.
He is damage +1.
Each time Sauron wins a skirmish and the companion he is skirmishing is not killed, you may assign X wounds to other companions, where X is the current region number.

title: Bilbo
gametext:
Ring-bound.
While Bilbo is not assigned to a skirmish, each Ring-bound Hobbit is strength +1.
At the start of each skirmish involving Bilbo, you may remove a burden for each other Ring-bound Hobbit you can spot.
subtitle: Aged Ring-bearer

title: Bill the Pony
gametext:
Bearer must be a Ring-bound Hobbit.
When you play Bill the Pony, you may reinforce a [shire] token.
Regroup: Spot 2 minions and remove 2 [shire] tokens to make a Shadow player discard a minion from play.
subtitle: Dearly-loved

title: Daddy Twofoot
gametext:
Aid – Add a burden. (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add a burden to transfer this to a companion.)
Each time you transfer this to a companion, you may take a [shire] event into hand from your discard pile.
subtitle: Next-door Neighbor

title: Don't Let Go
gametext: Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a Hobbit strength +1 for each of the following that is true: he or she is participating in a fierce skirmish; he or she has resistance 7 or more; he or she is at a dwelling site; you can spot an unwounded Hobbit.

title: Everything but My Bones
gametext:
You may remove from the game 4 other [shire] cards in your discard pile to play this event from your discard pile. Then remove this event from the game.
Make your Hobbit at a dwelling or forest site strength +3.

title: Faith in Friendship
gametext:
When you play this, add a [shire] token here.
At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard this from play or remove a token from here to heal a [shire] companion.

title: Fates Entwined
gametext: Each time a Hobbit wins a skirmish, you may heal another Hobbit once (or heal another Hobbit twice if the Hobbit that won the skirmish was Frodo or Bilbo).

title: Frodo
gametext:
Ring-bound.
While you can spot more minions than companions, Frodo cannot be overwhelmed unless his strength is tripled.
Skirmish: If Frodo is not assigned to a skirmish, exert Frodo to have him replace a Ring-bound companion skirmishing a minion.
subtitle: Frenzied Fighter

title: Frodo Gamgee
gametext:
Aid – Add 2 burdens. (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add 2 burdens to transfer this to a companion.)
To play, spot a Ring-bound Hobbit.
Bearer is strength +1 for each Ring-bound Hobbit you can spot.
subtitle: Son of Samwise

title: The Gaffer
gametext:
Aid – Add a burden. (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add a burden to transfer this to a companion.)
When you transfer The Gaffer to a [shire] companion, heal bearer (or heal bearer twice if he or she is at a dwelling site).
subtitle: Master Gardener

title: Humble Homestead
gametext:
To play, spot 2 Hobbits.
When you play this, add a [shire] token here for each forest site and each dwelling site on the adventure path.
Skirmish: Discard this from play or remove 3 tokens from here to cancel a skirmish involving a Hobbit.

title: Mithril-coat
gametext:
Bearer must be a Ring-bound Hobbit.
Each minion skirmishing bearer loses all damage bonuses.
Skirmish: Exert bearer to make each minion he is skirmishing lose fierce and unable to gain fierce until the regroup phase.
subtitle: Dwarf-mail

title: New Chapter
gametext:
To play, spot 2 Hobbits.
Each time you play a follower, you may heal a companion (or heal Sam twice).

title: Phial of Galadriel
gametext:
Bearer must be a Ring-bound Hobbit.
While bearer is in region 1, bearer gains muster.
While bearer is in region 2, each of your [shire] companions gains muster.
While bearer is in region 3, each character gains muster.
subtitle: The Light of Eärendil

title: Sam
gametext:
Ring-bound.
Sam is resistance +1 for each Hobbit you can spot.
Regroup: Exert Sam and transfer a follower he is bearing to your support area to discard a minion from play.
subtitle: Bearer of Great Need

title: Westfarthing Businessman
gametext: This companion is strength +1 for each [shire] card that has a culture token on it.

title: Assault Commander
gametext:
Damage +1.
Shadow: Exert this minion and spot a Free Peoples condition to make an unbound companion resistance -1 for each card that has the same card title as that condition.

title: Assault Denizen
gametext:
Damage +1.
This minion is strength +1 for each Free Peoples culture token you can spot.

title: Cavern Denizen
gametext:
Damage +1.
While you can spot a Free Peoples culture token, this minion cannot take wounds except during skirmishes.

title: Endless Assault
gametext: Skirmish: Discard this condition to make an [uruk-hai] minion strength +1 for each of the following that is true: it is at a battleground site; it is skirmishing a companion who has resistance 4 or less; it is bearing a possession; you can spot an [uruk-hai] minion not assigned to a skirmish.

title: Enemy Without Number
gametext:
To play, spot 2 [uruk-hai] minions.
Shadow: Discard 2 cards from hand to add (1).
Regroup: Spot an [uruk-hai] minion and discard this condition from play to add (3).

title: Entranced Uruk
gametext:
Damage +1. Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.)
Possessions borne by this minion cannot be discarded by Free Peoples cards.

title: Fearless Approach
gametext:
To play, spot an [uruk-hai] minion.
When you play this, if you spot a battleground site on the adventure path, reinforce 3 [uruk-hai] tokens.
Each time the Free Peoples player plays the fellowship's next site, you may discard a condition from play.

title: Isengard Infiltrator
gametext:
Damage +1.
While the fellowship is at a forest site, the fellowship archery total is -1.
Each [elven] companion skirmishing this minion is strength -2.

title: New Enemy
gametext:
You may remove from the game 4 [uruk-hai] cards in your discard pile instead of paying the twilight cost for this card.
Make your [uruk-hai] minion skirmishing a companion with resistance 4 or less strength +2.

title: Signs of War
gametext: While you can spot 3 [uruk-hai] lurker minions, at the start of each skirmish involving an [uruk-hai] lurker minion, each companion skirmishing that minion must exert.

title: Uruk Aggressor
gametext:
Damage +1.
When you play this, you may spot a companion who has resistance 0 to make this minion twilight cost -2.

title: Uruk Blitz
gametext:
To play, spot an [uruk-hai] minion.
While the fellowship is in region 1, each Uruk-hai is damage +1.
While the fellowship is in region 2, each companion is strength -1.
While the fellowship is in region 3, each unbound companion is resistance -2.

title: Uruk Distractor
gametext:
Damage +1.
Skirmish: If this minion is not assigned to a skirmish, you may exert it to discard a possession borne by a companion skirmishing another [uruk-hai] minion.

title: Uruk Invader
gametext:
Damage +1.
This minion is twilight cost -1 for each companion who has resistance 2 or less.

title: Uruk Outrider
gametext: This minion is damage +1 for each character in the dead pile.

title: Uruk Reserve
gametext:
Damage +1. Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.)
Each time your [uruk-hai] minion is about to be killed in a skirmish, you may place that minion on the bottom of your draw deck instead.

title: Uruk Rogue
gametext:
Damage +1.
Skirmish: If no other minions are assigned to a skirmish, exert this minion twice to make it fierce and strength +4 until the regroup phase.

title: Uruk Tactician
gametext:
Damage +1.
Skirmish: Exert this minion to make a companion skirmishing an [uruk-hai] lurker minion strength -2.

title: War Machine
gametext: Exert your [uruk-hai] lurker minion to play an [uruk-hai] hand weapon from your discard pile on your [uruk-hai] minion.

title: Weapons of Control
gametext:
When you play this, add an [uruk-hai] token here for each wounded companion.
Skirmish: Discard this from play or remove 2 tokens from here to make a companion skirmishing an [uruk-hai] minion strength -1.

title: Dark Fell About Him
gametext:
To play, exert your Nazgûl twice and spot an exhausted companion.
Heal that companion to add a burden. If the fellowship is not in region 1, you may repeat this for each other wound on that companion.

title: From Hideous Eyrie
gametext:
You may remove from the game 4 [wraith] cards in your discard pile instead of paying the twilight cost for this card.
Make your Nazgûl in a fierce skirmish strength +2.

title: Shadow in the East
gametext:
Toil 1. (For each [wraith] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -1.)
To play, spot a [wraith] card in your support area.
Spot a companion to draw a card for each wound on that companion (and draw an additional card if you can spot a Nazgûl).

title: They Came From Mordor
gametext:
When you play this, you may add a [wraith] token here for each [wraith] card in your support area.
Shadow: Discard this from play or remove 2 tokens from here to play a [wraith] mount from your draw deck on your [wraith] minion.

title: Úlairë Enquëa
gametext:
Fierce.
When you play Úlairë Enquëa, if you can spot 2 other Nazgûl, you may exert 2 unbound companions (or exert each companion if you can spot 6 companions).
subtitle: Sixth of the Nine Riders

title: Úlairë Lemenya
gametext:
Fierce.
Shadow: Exert Úlairë Lemenya and discard a Nazgûl from your hand to discard a condition from play.
subtitle: Servant of the Shadow

title: Úlairë Nertëa
gametext:
Fierce.
While you can spot a companion who has resistance 3 or less, Úlairë Nertëa is twilight cost -2.
subtitle: Servant of the Shadow

title: Abandoned Mine Shaft
gametext: Underground. If this site is not in region 1 when the fellowship moves from here during the regroup phase, add a burden.

title: Caves of Aglarond
gametext: Underground. When the fellowship moves to this site during the regroup phase, the Free Peoples player may remove 2 burdens.

title: City of Kings
gametext: Battleground. When the fellowship moves to this site during the regroup phase, the Free Peoples player may draw a card.

title: Courtyard Parapet
gametext: Dwelling. When the fellowship moves to this site, the first Shadow player may discard 2 cards from hand to add a burden.

title: Crossroads of the Fallen Kings
gametext: Forest. When the fellowship moves to this site during the regroup phase, the Free Peoples player may heal a companion of each culture.

title: Doors of Durin
gametext: Marsh. Each companion of each race that has the most companions is strength -1.

title: Fords of Isen
gametext: River. Each character is strength +1 for each card borne by that character.

title: The Great Gates
gametext: Battleground. While a player can spot more companions than minions, each minion is strength +1.

title: Isenwash
gametext: Battleground. Plains. At the start of the regroup phase, each Shadow player may exert a minion to exert a companion.

title: Redhorn Pass
gametext: Mountain. Culture tokens cannot be added, removed, or reinforced.

title: Dáin Ironfoot
gametext:
Each of your other Dwarves and [gandalf] Men is twilight cost -1.
At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a [dwarven] or [gandalf] condition from play to discard a minion from play.
subtitle: King Under the Mountain

title: Elladan
gametext:
Elrohir is twilight cost -2.
Each time you play an [elven] event during a skirmish involving Elladan or Elrohir, that event is twilight cost -2.
subtitle: Son of Elrond

title: Elrohir
gametext:
Elladan is twilight cost -2.
Each time you play an [elven] event during a skirmish involving Elrohir or Elladan, each minion in that skirmish is strength -2.
subtitle: Son of Elrond

title: Gildor Inglorion
gametext: At the start of each archery phase, if you can spot more minions than companions, each of your companions is an archer.
subtitle: Of the House of Finrod

title: Brand
gametext:
Each of your Dwarves and other [gandalf] Men is strength +1.
While you can spot more minions than companions, the fellowship archery total is +X, where X is the number of minions minus the number of companions.
subtitle: King of Dale

title: Grimbeorn
gametext:
At the start of each turn, heal Grimbeorn.
At the start of the maneuver phase, you may exert Grimbeorn twice and discard a minion from hand to make Grimbeorn strength +X until the regroup phase, where X is that minion's strength.
subtitle: Beorning Chieftain

title: Duilin
gametext:
Ranger.
While the fellowship is at a forest or river site, Duilin is strength +3.
subtitle: Ranger From Blackroot Vale

title: Duinhir
gametext:
While you can spot a mount, Duinhir is damage +1.
Each time Duinhir wins a skirmish, if you can spot more minions than companions, you may exert him to discard a minion that has strength 7 or less.
subtitle: Tall Man of Blackroot Vale

title: Halbarad
gametext:
Ranger.
While the Ring-bearer has resistance 9 or more, Halbarad's twilight cost is -1.
At the start of the maneuver phase, you may discard a [gondor] card from hand to heal a [gondor] companion.
subtitle: Ranger of the North

title: Furious Hillman
gametext: Response: If the Free Peoples player plays an event, spot another [men] Man and discard this minion from play to cancel that event.

title: Swarming Hillman
gametext: At the start of the regroup phase, if you can spot more Man characters than any other race, make the move limit -1 this turn.

title: Half-troll of Far Harad
gametext: At the start of each assignment phase, if you can spot more companions than minions, you may remove (2) to play an [orc] Orc from your discard pile.

title: Horror of Harad
gametext: Ambush (1). Damage +1. Fierce. Lurker. Muster. Toil 2.

title: Uruk-hai Healer
gametext:
Damage +1.
At the start of each assignment phase, you may heal an Uruk-hai for each companion you can spot.

title: Uruk-hai Scout
gametext:
Damage +1.
When you play this, choose one of the following keywords: battleground, mountain, plains, or underground. The fellowship's current site gains that keyword until the end of the turn.

title: The One Ring
gametext:
While wearing The One Ring, the Ring-bearer gains hunter 3, and each time he or she is about to take a wound in a skirmish, add a burden instead.
Skirmish: Add a burden to wear The One Ring until the regroup phase.
subtitle: The Ring of Doom

title: The One Ring
gametext:
Response: If the Ring-bearer is about to take a wound in a skirmish, he or she wears The One Ring until the regroup phase.
While the Ring-bearer is wearing The One Ring, each time he or she is about to take a wound in a skirmish, add a burden instead.
subtitle: The Ruling Ring

title: Chamber of Records
gametext:
When you play this, you may spot a Dwarf to place 2 [dwarven] tokens here.
Fellowship: Discard this from play or remove a [dwarven] token from here to reveal the top card of your draw deck. If it is a [dwarven] card, take it into your hand, otherwise, place it in your discard pile.

title: The Fortunes of Balin's Folk
gametext: Exert a Dwarf to shuffle a [dwarven] condition with one or more [dwarven] tokens on it into your draw deck. Wound a minion for each [dwarven] token that was on that condition.

title: Gimli
gametext: Damage +1. Hunter 3. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +3.)
subtitle: Eager Hunter

title: Glóin
gametext:
Each time Glóin wins a skirmish, you may draw 3 cards, then place 3 cards from your hand beneath your draw deck in any order.
Skirmish: Remove a [dwarven] token to make Glóin strength +2.
subtitle: Son of Gróin

title: Heavy Axe
gametext:
Bearer must be a Dwarf.
This is twilight cost -1 for each [dwarven] card that has a culture token on it.
Skirmish: Remove a [dwarven] token to make bearer strength +1.

title: Sturdy Stock
gametext: Make a Dwarf strength +2 (or if you can spot a hunter minion, strength +1 and damage +1 for each hunter minion you can spot).

title: Well-crafted Armor
gametext:
Bearer must be a Dwarf. Each time bearer takes a wound, you may reinforce a [dwarven] token.
Skirmish: Discard a [dwarven] card from hand to make bearer damage +1.

title: Whatever End
gametext:
Each time Gimli wins a skirmish, you may make a hunter [gondor] companion or hunter [elven] companion damage +1 until the regroup phase.
Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a [dwarven] companion strength +2.

title: Arwen
gametext:
While you can spot Aragorn, Arwen is strength +1 and resistance +2.
Skirmish: Remove an [elven] token to make a minion skirmishing Arwen strength -2.
subtitle: She-Elf

title: Dínendal
gametext:
Aid – (3). (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add (3) to transfer this to a companion.)
Each time you transfer this to a companion, except an [elven] companion, exert bearer.
Bearer is an archer.
subtitle: Mirkwood Archer

title: Elven Bow
gametext:
Bearer must be an Elf.
Bearer is an archer.

title: Elven Warrior
gametext:
While this companion is bearing a possession, he is strength +2.
Maneuver: Exert this companion to place an [elven] card from your discard pile on the bottom of your draw deck.

title: Focus
gametext:
Each time Legolas wins a skirmish, you may heal a hunter [dwarven] Dwarf or hunter [gondor] Man.
Skirmish: Discard this condition to make an [elven] Elf strength +2.

title: Gift of the Evenstar
gametext:
Each time an Elf wins a skirmish, you may exert that Elf or Aragorn to place an [elven] token here.
At the start of each maneuver phase, you may remove an [elven] token here to draw a card.
subtitle: Blessed Light

title: Haldir
gametext:
To play, spot an Elf.
While the fellowship is at a battleground site, Haldir is strength +2.
While the fellowship is at a forest site, Haldir is an archer.
subtitle: Sentry of the Golden Wood

title: Legolas
gametext:
Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
Regroup: Exert 2 hunter companions to draw a card.
subtitle: Fleet-footed Hunter

title: Legolas
gametext:
Archer. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
Archery: Exert Legolas to make the fellowship archery total +1 for each hunter minion you can spot (limit +3).
subtitle: Of the Woodland Realm

title: Lórien's Blessing
gametext: Spot an [elven] follower to make the minion archery total -3.

title: Mighty Shot
gametext: Spot an Elf to make the fellowship archery total +1 for each minion with a twilight cost of 2 or less that you can spot.

title: The Mirror of Galadriel
gametext:
To play, spot 3 Elves.
Each time you are about to draw a card, you may exert an Elf to look at the top three cards of your draw deck instead. Take a Free Peoples card into your hand and place the other cards on the bottom of your draw deck.
subtitle: Dangerous Guide

title: Point Blank Range
gametext: Make an Elf strength +2 (or +4 if you can spot 3 archers).

title: Spied From Afar
gametext:
To play, spot 3 Elves.
While you can spot an [elven] follower, the twilight cost of each Shadow possession is +1.
Skirmish: Discard this condition to make an [elven] companion strength +1 for each archer companion you can spot.

title: Sword of the Fallen
gametext:
Bearer must be an Elf.
Each minion skirmishing bearer is strength -1 for each wound on that minion.
Skirmish: Exert bearer to exert a minion skirmishing bearer.

title: Uruviel
gametext:
Aid – (1). (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add (1) to transfer this to a companion.)
Each time you transfer this to a companion, you may exert an Elf to make the fellowship's current site a forest until the end of the turn.
subtitle: Woodland Maid

title: Be Gone!
gametext: Spell. Exert your [gandalf] companion X times to make a minion strength -2 until the regroup phase, for each time that [gandalf] companion exerted.

title: Ent Avenger
gametext: While you can spot 3 Ents, this companion is strength +2.

title: Gandalf
gametext:
To play, spot 2 Hobbits.
Each time you play a spell, you may add a burden to wound a minion.
At the start of each skirmish involving Gandalf, you may draw a card and then discard a card from your hand.
subtitle: Powerful Guide

title: Leaflock
gametext:
Leaflock's twilight cost is -1 for each Ent you can spot.
While you can spot 4 other Ents, Leaflock is strength +4.
subtitle: Finglas

title: Mellon!
gametext:
To play, spot 2 [gandalf] companions.
At the start of the maneuver phase, discard this condition to make each player count the number of cards in his or her hand, discard each of them and draw the same number of cards from the top of his or her draw deck.

title: Momentous Gathering
gametext: Choose one: spot an Ent to take a [gandalf] companion into hand from your draw deck; or spot 2 Ents to take a [gandalf] companion and a [gandalf] condition into hand from your draw deck. Shuffle your draw deck.

title: One Last Surprise
gametext: Spell. Spot Gandalf and an unbound companion skirmishing a minion to use Gandalf's resistance to resolve that skirmish instead of that companion's strength.

title: Quickbeam
gametext:
Quickbeam is twilight cost -1 for each Ent you can spot.
Maneuver: Discard this companion to place another [gandalf] companion from your discard pile on the bottom of your draw deck and reinforce a [gandalf] token.
subtitle: Hastiest of All Ents

title: Shadow of the Wood
gametext:
This companion is twilight cost -1 for each [gandalf] companion you can spot.
Fellowship: Place this companion in the dead pile to remove (5).

title: Shepherd of the Trees
gametext:
While you can spot 4 Ents, this companion is strength +3.
Maneuver: Exert this companion to reveal the bottom card of your draw deck. If it is a [gandalf] character, you may play it.

title: Skinbark
gametext:
Skinbark is twilight cost -1 for each [gandalf] condition you can spot.
Each time Skinbark wins a skirmish, you may place a [gandalf] card from your discard pile beneath your draw deck.
subtitle: Elder Ent

title: Treebeard
gametext:
To play, spot 3 [gandalf] companions.
Each time Treebeard wins a skirmish, the first Shadow player must exert X minions, where X is the difference between Treebeard's strength and the losing character's strength.
subtitle: Enraged Shepherd

title: Called to Mordor
gametext:
Bearer must be Sméagol.
While you can spot 2 Ring-bound Hobbits, each time an opponent uses a skirmish special ability in a skirmish involving Gollum or Sméagol, you may wound a minion.

title: Connected By Fate
gametext:
To play, spot Sméagol.
While you can spot 2 Ring-bound Hobbits, each Shadow event is twilight cost +1.
Skirmish: Discard this condition to make each Ring-bound companion strength +1 until the regroup phase.

title: Controlled By The Ring
gametext:
Bearer must be Gollum.
Skirmish: If Gollum is not assigned to a skirmish, discard this condition to have him replace a minion skirmishing a companion.

title: Desperate Move
gametext: Discard a [gollum] minion from play to discard a companion. The Free Peoples player may make the move limit -1 this turn to prevent that.

title: Gollum
gametext: At the start of each skirmish involving Gollum, he is strength +X until the end of that skirmish, where X is the Ring-bearer's strength.
subtitle: Hopeless

title: Herbs and Stewed Rabbit
gametext:
While you can spot Frodo, Sméagol is resistance +1.
While you can spot Sam, Sméagol is strength +1.
While you can spot Bilbo, Sméagol is damage +1.

title: Hurry Hobbitses
gametext: Make Sméagol strength +1 for each Ring- bound Hobbit you can spot.

title: Nice Fish
gametext:
Each time Sméagol wins a skirmish, place a [gollum] token here.
Regroup: Heal a Ring-bound companion for each token here. Discard this condition.

title: Not This Time!
gametext: Skirmish: Exert Gollum and remove a threat to wound a companion Gollum is skirmishing.

title: Release Them
gametext:
Spot Sméagol to prevent a Ring-bound Hobbit from being overwhelmed unless his or her strength is tripled.
While this card is in your discard pile, Sméagol is resistance +1.

title: Sméagol
gametext:
Ring-bound. To play, add a burden.
Each Ring-bound companion is resistance +1.
Skirmish: Exert 2 Ring-bound Hobbits to make Sméagol strength +1 and prevent him from being overwhelmed unless his strength is tripled.
subtitle: Wretched and Hungry

title: Something Slimy
gametext: Spot Sméagol to play a condition from your draw deck. If that condition was a [gollum] condition, you may make an opponent place a random card from his or her hand beneath his or her draw deck.

title: Sudden Strike
gametext: Spot Gollum or Sméagol to play a minion from your draw deck. If that minion is a [gollum] minion, you may also play a Shadow possession or Shadow condition from your draw deck. Shuffle your draw deck.

title: Swear by the Precious
gametext: Spot Frodo and Sméagol to discard a minion. That minion's owner may make each minion strength -2 until the end of the turn to prevent that.

title: Unseen Foe
gametext: Discard a [gollum] minion from play to wound each companion with strength 8 or more.

title: Aragorn
gametext:
Ranger. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
Skirmish: Exert Aragorn to make a hunter companion strength +1.
subtitle: Swift Hunter

title: Aragorn
gametext:
Ranger. Hunter 2. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +2.)
Maneuver: Add a threat to exert a non- hunter minion with strength less than Aragorn.
subtitle: Thorongil

title: Aragorn's Bow
gametext:
Bearer must be Aragorn.
He is an archer.
Archery: Add a threat to wound a minion with the lowest strength.
subtitle: Ranger's Longbow

title: Damrod
gametext:
Ranger. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
At the start of each fellowship phase, you may add (1) to heal a ranger.
subtitle: Dúnadan of Gondor

title: Decorated Barricade
gametext:
Fortification. This condition is twilight cost -1 for each [gondor] ranger you spot.
Skirmish: Exert 2 [gondor] Men to transfer this condition from your support area to a minion skirmishing a [gondor] Man.

title: Dúnedain of the South
gametext:
Ranger. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
Each time this companion wins a skirmish, you may make a [gondor] ranger strength +2 until the regroup phase.

title: Gondorian Prowler
gametext:
Ranger. Hunter 1.
When this companion is in your starting fellowship, he is twilight cost -1.
Skirmish: Remove a [gondor] token or exert a [gondor] Man to make the site number of a minion +2.

title: Ithilien Blade
gametext:
Bearer must be a [gondor] Man.
While you can spot a roaming minion, bearer is strength +1.
Maneuver: Exert bearer twice to discard a roaming minion.

title: Mablung
gametext:
Ranger. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
Skirmish: Exert Mablung to wound a roaming minion he is skirmishing.
subtitle: Ranger of Ithilien

title: Madril
gametext:
Ranger. Hunter 1.
While you can spot 2 [gondor] rangers, Madril is twilight cost -2.
At the start of the maneuver phase, each minion is site number +1 for each threat you can spot until the start of the regroup phase.
subtitle: Defender of Osgiliath

title: No Quicker Path
gametext:
Each time Aragorn wins a skirmish, you may make a hunter [dwarven] companion or hunter [elven] companion strength +1 until the regroup phase.
Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a [gondor] Man strength +2.

title: No Travellers In This Land
gametext: Exert a [gondor] Man to wound a minion (or wound that minion twice if it is a hunter).

title: Portico
gametext:
Fortification. The twilight cost of this condition is -1 for each [gondor] ranger you spot.
Skirmish: Exert a [gondor] Man or spot 2 rangers to transfer this condition from your support area to a minion skirmishing a [gondor] Man.

title: Ranger's Cloak
gametext:
Bearer must be a [gondor] Man.
While bearer is a ranger or at a forest site, each minion skirmishing bearer is site number +2.
Skirmish: Add a threat or exert bearer to make a minion skirmishing a [gondor] Man site number +2.

title: Silent Traveler
gametext:
Ranger. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
At the start of each skirmish involving this companion and a roaming minion, you may reinforce a [gondor] token.

title: Tremendous Wall
gametext:
Fortification. Characters skirmishing bearer cannot take wounds from losing a skirmish involving bearer.
Skirmish: Exert a [gondor] Man or spot 3 rangers to transfer this condition from your support area to a minion skirmishing a [gondor] Man.

title: Unyielding Ranger
gametext:
Ranger. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
This companion is strength +1 for each roaming minion you can spot.

title: Bill Ferny
gametext:
If Bill Ferny is unwounded, the Free Peoples player cannot assign him to skirmish a companion.
Shadow: Exert Bill Ferny twice and spot a site you control to add (2).
subtitle: Agent of Saruman

title: Bold Easterling
gametext: Skirmish: If this minion is skirmishing, discard this minion to play a [men] minion from your discard pile. That minion is fierce until the regroup phase.

title: Chieftain of Dunland
gametext:
Fierce.
Skirmish: Spot a site you control and remove (2) to make a [men] Man strength +2.
Skirmish: Spot 2 sites you control and remove (2) to make a [men] Man strength +3.
Skirmish: Spot 3 sites you control and remove (2) to make a [men] Man strength +4.

title: Courageous Easterling
gametext: Skirmish: If this minion is skirmishing, discard this minion to play a [men] minion from your discard pile. That minion is fierce until the regroup phase.

title: Destroyed Homestead
gametext: When you play this, spot 2 [men] Men to randomly reveal a site from the Free Peoples player's adventure deck. Note its card title. Each site on the adventure path with the same card title as the selected site loses its game text.

title: Easterling Scout
gametext: Skirmish: If this minion is skirmishing, discard this minion to play a [men] minion from your discard pile. That minion is fierce until the regroup phase.

title: Engrossed Hillman
gametext: At the start of the maneuver phase, if you can spot another [men] Man and 8 characters (or if you can spot 3 Free Peoples cultures), you may take control of a site.

title: Enraged Herdsman
gametext: While you can spot more companions than minions, each [men] hunter is strength +2 and is an archer.

title: Great Axe
gametext:
Bearer must be a [men] Man.
While bearer is skirmishing a hunter companion, bearer is strength +2.

title: Grieving the Fallen
gametext:
To play, spot a [men] Man. Bearer must be a companion (except the Ring-bearer).
Bearer cannot take wounds during the archery phase. At the start of the regroup phase, discard this condition.

title: Grousing Hillman
gametext: While you control a site, this minion is strength +3 and fierce.

title: Hunting Herdsman
gametext:
Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
This minion is strength +3 for each follower you can spot.

title: Last Gasp
gametext: Wound 3 [men] archers to exhaust a companion.

title: Lying Counsel
gametext: Exert your [men] Man and spot an unbound companion bearing 3 or more cards to return each Free Peoples card that companion bears to its owner's hand. The Free Peoples player may add a burden to discard those cards instead.

title: Mûmak Commander
gametext: Maneuver: Exert Mûmak Commander twice to exert a companion twice (except the Ring-bearer).
subtitle: Giant Among the Swertings

title: Primitive Savage
gametext:
While you can spot a companion of strength 12 or more, this minion is strength +5.
Each time this minion wins a skirmish, if he bears a hand weapon, you may take control of a site.

title: Pursuing Horde
gametext:
To play, spot a [men] Man. Bearer must be a companion (except the Ring-bearer). Limit 1 per companion.
Each time the fellowship moves, add (1).

title: Rapid Reload
gametext:
While you can spot a [men] Man, the Free Peoples player cannot replace a site in the current region.
Archery: Spot a [men] Man and remove (3) to exert an unbound companion.

title: Rapt Hillman
gametext:
At the start of the regroup phase, the Free People's player may liberate a site. You may spot 3 Men to prevent this.
Maneuver: Spot another [men] Man and exert this minion to take control of a site.

title: Ravaging Wild Man
gametext:
While you can spot a hunter, this minion gains hunter 1.
Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may exert 2 [men] Men to discard a follower.

title: Savage Southron
gametext: Maneuver: If the Free People's player has at least 1 site in his or her adventure deck, exert 2 [men] Men to randomly choose a site from that deck. Replace the fellowship's current site with that site.

title: Swarthy Hillman
gametext: While you control a site, this minion is an archer.

title: Wandering Hillman
gametext:
To play, spot a [men] Man.
While you can spot a companion of strength 10 or more, this minion is strength +3.
Maneuver: Remove 2 burdens or 2 threats to control a site.

title: Battlefield Recruit
gametext: Skirmish: Discard this minion to make a minion strength +2.

title: Battlefield Veteran
gametext: Skirmish: Discard this minion to make a minion strength +1.

title: Beasts of Burden
gametext:
To play, spot 2 [orc] minions.
At the start of your Shadow phase, you may discard an [orc] condition from play to play an [orc] minion. It is twilight cost -2 (or -4 if you can spot 6 or more companions).

title: Black Gate Sentry
